bhogaiśca bhogasaṃskāraiḥ kālatritayagocaraiḥ ||
7.2.d:
आशयैर्नापि सम्बन्धः संस्कारैः कर्मणामपि ।
भोगैश्च भोगसंस्कारैः कालत्रितयगोचरैः ॥
7.2.m: nor with experiences and the traces of experiences pertaining to the three times. / He has no cause, no agent, no beginning, no end, and no interval;

7.2.s:
na tasya kāraṇaṃ kartā nādirantastathāntaram |
na karma karaṇaṃ vāpi nākāryaṃ kāryameva ca ||
7.2.d:
न तस्य कारणं कर्ता नादिरन्तस्तथान्तरम् ।
न कर्म करणं वापि नाकार्यं कार्यमेव च ॥

7.2.s:
nāsya bandhurabandhurvā niyantā prerako'pi vā |
na patirna gurustrātā nādhiko na samastathā ||
7.2.d:
नास्य बन्धुरबन्धुर्वा नियन्ता प्रेरकोऽपि वा ।
न पतिर्न गुरुस्त्राता नाधिको न समस्तथा ॥

7.2.s:
na janmamaraṇe tasya na kāṅkṣitamakāṅkṣitam |
na vidhirna niṣedhaśca na muktirna ca bandhanam ||
7.2.d:
न जन्ममरणे तस्य न काङ्क्षितमकाङ्क्षितम् ।
न विधिर्न निषेधश्च न मुक्तिर्न च बन्धनम् ॥
7.2.m: He has no injunction and no prohibition, no liberation and no bondage; / whatever is inauspicious never belongs to him at any time.

7.2.s:
nāsti yadyadakalyāṇaṃ tattadasya kadācana |
kalyāṇaṃ sakalaṃ cāsti paramātmā śivo yataḥ ||
7.2.d:
नास्ति यद्यदकल्याणं तत्तदस्य कदाचन ।
कल्याणं सकलं चास्ति परमात्मा शिवो यतः ॥

7.2.s:
sa śivaḥ sarvamevedamadhiṣṭhāya svaśaktibhiḥ |
apracyutaḥ svato bhāvaḥ sthitaḥ sthāṇurataḥ smṛtaḥ ||
7.2.d:
स शिवः सर्वमेवेदमधिष्ठाय स्वशक्तिभिः ।
अप्रच्युतः स्वतो भावः स्थितः स्थाणुरतः स्मृतः ॥

7.2.s:
śivenādhiṣṭhitaṃ yasmāt jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam |
sarvarūpaḥ smṛtaḥ śarvastathā jñātvā na muhyati ||
7.2.d:
शिवेनाधिष्ठितं यस्मात् जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् ।
सर्वरूपः स्मृतः शर्वस्तथा ज्ञात्वा न मुह्यति ॥

7.2.s:
śarvo rudro namastasmai puruṣaḥ satparo mahān |
hiraṇyabāhurbhagavān hiraṇyapatirīśvaraḥ ||
7.2.d:
शर्वो रुद्रो नमस्तस्मै पुरुषः सत्परो महान् ।
हिरण्यबाहुर्भगवान् हिरण्यपतिरीश्वरः ॥
7.2.m: Śarva is remembered as having all forms; knowing [him] thus, one is not deluded. / Śarva, Rudra—homage to him, the Puruṣa, the real, the supreme, the great,

7.2.s:
ambikāpatirīśānaḥ pinākī vṛṣavāhanaḥ |
eko rudraḥ paraṃ brahma puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ ||
7.2.d:
अम्बिकापतिरीशानः पिनाकी वृषवाहनः ।
एको रुद्रः परं ब्रह्म पुरुषः कृष्णपिङ्गलः ॥

7.2.s:
bālāgramātro hṛnmadhye vicintyo daharāntare |
hiraṇyakeśaḥ padmākṣo hyaruṇastāmra eva ca ||
7.2.d:
बालाग्रमात्रो हृन्मध्ये विचिन्त्यो दहरान्तरे ।
हिरण्यकेशः पद्माक्षो ह्यरुणस्ताम्र एव च ॥

7.2.s:
yo'vasarpatyasau devo nīlagrīvo hiraṇmayaḥ |
saumyo'ghorastathā miśraścākṣāraścāmṛto'vyayaḥ ||
7.2.d:
योऽवसर्पत्यसौ देवो नीलग्रीवो हिरण्मयः ।
सौम्योऽघोरस्तथा मिश्रश्चाक्षारश्चामृतोऽव्ययः ॥
7.2.m: gentle, terrible, and mixed, imperishable, immortal, immutable; / he is that supreme distinct soul, the blessed destroyer of Antaka,

7.2.s:
sa puṃviśeṣaḥ paramo bhagavānantakāntakaḥ |
cetanācetanonmuktaḥ prapañcācca parātparaḥ ||
7.2.d:
स पुंविशेषः परमो भगवानन्तकान्तकः ।
चेतनाचेतनोन्मुक्तः प्रपञ्चाच्च परात्परः ॥
7.2.m: freed from the conscious and unconscious and higher than the highest manifestation of the universe. / When knowledge and lordship are observed to be superior in Śiva,

7.2.s:
śivenātiśayatvena jñānaiśvarye vilokite |
lokeśātiśayatvena sthitaṃ prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ||
7.2.d:
शिवेनातिशयत्वेन ज्ञानैश्वर्ये विलोकिते ।
लोकेशातिशयत्वेन स्थितं प्राहुर्मनीषिणः ॥

7.2.s:
pratisargaprasūtānāṃ brahmaṇāṃ śāstravistaram |
upadeṣṭā sa evādau kālāvacchedavartinām ||
7.2.d:
प्रतिसर्गप्रसूतानां ब्रह्मणां शास्त्रविस्तरम् ।
उपदेष्टा स एवादौ कालावच्छेदवर्तिनाम् ॥
7.2.m: the wise state that he stands superior to the lords of the world. / He alone was the teacher in the beginning of the expanse of scriptures / to the Brahmās born in each creation, who were subject to the limitation of time.

7.2.s:
kālāvacchedayuktānāṃ gurūṇāmapyasau guruḥ |
sarveṣāmeva sarveśaḥ kālāvacchedavarjitaḥ ||
7.2.d:
कालावच्छेदयुक्तानां गुरूणामप्यसौ गुरुः ।
सर्वेषामेव सर्वेशः कालावच्छेदवर्जितः ॥

7.2.s:
śuddhā svābhāvikī tasya śaktiḥ sarvātiśāyinī |
jñānamapratimaṃ nityaṃ vapuratyantanirmilam ||
7.2.d:
शुद्धा स्वाभाविकी तस्य शक्तिः सर्वातिशायिनी ।
ज्ञानमप्रतिमं नित्यं वपुरत्यन्तनिर्मिलम् ॥

7.2.s:
aiśvaryamapratidvandvaṃ sukhamātyantikaṃ balam |
tejaḥprabhāvo vīryaṃ ca kṣamā kāruṇyameva ca ||
7.2.d:
ऐश्वर्यमप्रतिद्वन्द्वं सुखमात्यन्तिकं बलम् ।
तेजःप्रभावो वीर्यं च क्षमा कारुण्यमेव च ॥

7.2.s:
paripūrṇasya sargādyairnātmano'sti prayojanam |
parānugraha evāsya phalaṃ sarvasya karmaṇaḥ ||
7.2.d:
परिपूर्णस्य सर्गाद्यैर्नात्मनोऽस्ति प्रयोजनम् ।
परानुग्रह एवास्य फलं सर्वस्य कर्मणः ॥
7.2.m: splendor, power, vigor, forbearance, and compassion [unmatched]. / For him who is completely full, there is no self-serving purpose in creation and the rest;

7.2.s:
praṇavo vācakastasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ |
śivarudrādiśabdānāṃ praṇavo hi paraḥ smṛtaḥ ||
7.2.d:
प्रणवो वाचकस्तस्य शिवस्य परमात्मनः ।
शिवरुद्रादिशब्दानां प्रणवो हि परः स्मृतः ॥
7.2.m: The Praṇava is the designator of that Śiva, the Supreme Self; / for among words such as 'Śiva' and 'Rudra', the Praṇava is declared to be supreme.

7.2.s:
śambhoḥ praṇavavācyasya bhavanāttajjapādapi |
yā siddhiḥ sā parā prāpyā bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||
7.2.d:
शम्भोः प्रणववाच्यस्य भवनात्तज्जपादपि ।
या सिद्धिः सा परा प्राप्या भवत्येव न संशयः ॥
7.2.m: From contemplating Śambhu, who is designated by the Praṇava, and from repeating it, / whatever accomplishment is highest is indeed attained; there is no doubt.

7.2.s:
tasmādekākṣaraṃ devamāhurāgamapāragāḥ |
vācyavācakayoraikyaṃ manyamānā manasvinaḥ ||
7.2.d:
तस्मादेकाक्षरं देवमाहुरागमपारगाः ।
वाच्यवाचकयोरैक्यं मन्यमाना मनस्विनः ॥
7.2.m: Therefore those who have mastered the Āgamas call the god the Single Syllable, / those wise men regarding the identity of the designated and the designator.

7.2.s:
asya mātrāḥ samākhyātāścatasro vedamūrddhani |
akāraścāpyukāraśca makāro nāda ityapi ||
7.2.d:
अस्य मात्राः समाख्याताश्चतस्रो वेदमूर्द्धनि ।
अकारश्चाप्युकारश्च मकारो नाद इत्यपि ॥
7.2.m: Its morae are declared to be four at the head of the Vedas: / the letter A, the letter U, the letter M, and also the sound (nāda).

7.2.s:
akāraṃ bahvṛcaṃ prāhurukāro yajurucyate |
makāraḥ sāmanādo'sya śrutirātharvaṇī smṛtā ||
7.2.d:
अकारं बह्वृचं प्राहुरुकारो यजुरुच्यते ।
मकारः सामनादोऽस्य श्रुतिराथर्वणी स्मृता ॥
7.2.m: They call the letter A the Ṛgveda; the letter U is called the Yajurveda; / the letter M is the Sāmaveda, and its sound is declared to be the Atharvanic revelation.

7.2.s:
akāraśca mahābījaṃ rajaḥ sraṣṭā caturmukhaḥ |
ukāraḥ prakṛtiryoniḥ sattvaṃ pālayitā hariḥ ||
7.2.d:
अकारश्च महाबीजं रजः स्रष्टा चतुर्मुखः ।
उकारः प्रकृतिर्योनिः सत्त्वं पालयिता हरिः ॥
7.2.m: The letter A is the great seed, the rajas quality, the four-faced creator [Brahmā]; / the letter U is primordial matter, the womb, the sattva quality, the preserver Hari;

7.2.s:
makāraḥ puruṣo bījaṃ tamaḥ saṃhārako haraḥ |
nādaḥ paraḥ pumānīśo nirguṇo niṣkriyaḥ śivaḥ ||
7.2.d:
मकारः पुरुषो बीजं तमः संहारको हरः ।
नादः परः पुमानीशो निर्गुणो निष्क्रियः शिवः ॥
7.2.m: the letter M is the soul, the seed, the tamas quality, the destroyer Hara; / the sound is the supreme Puruṣa, the Lord, free from qualities, actionless Śiva.

7.2.s:
sarvaṃ tisṛbhirevedaṃ mātrābhirnikhilaṃ tridhā |
abhidhāya śivātmānaṃ bodhayatyardhamātrayā ||
7.2.d:
सर्वं तिसृभिरेवेदं मात्राभिर्निखिलं त्रिधा ।
अभिधाय शिवात्मानं बोधयत्यर्धमात्रया ॥
7.2.m: Having expressed all this entire universe threefold by its three morae alone, / it awakens the soul whose nature is Śiva by means of the half-mora.

7.2.s:
yasmātparaṃ nāparamasti kiñcid-yasmānnāṇīyo na jyāyo'sti kiñcit |
vṛkṣa iva stabdho divi tiṣṭhatyeka-stenedaṃ pūrṇaṃ puruṣeṇa sarvam ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
7.2.d:
यस्मात्परं नापरमस्ति किञ्चिद्-यस्मान्नाणीयो न ज्यायोऽस्ति किञ्चित् ।
वृक्ष इव स्तब्धो दिवि तिष्ठत्येक-स्तेनेदं पूर्णं पुरुषेण सर्वम् ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
7.2.m:
Than whom there is nothing higher or lower, than whom there is nothing smaller or greater; / standing like a tree unmoved in heaven, by that one Puruṣa all this is filled.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

7.2.s:
upamanyuruvaca |
śaktiḥ svābhavikī tasya vidyā viśvavilakṣaṇā |
ekānekasya rūpeṇa bhāti bhānoriva prabhā ||
7.2.d:
उपमन्युरुवच ।
शक्तिः स्वाभविकी तस्य विद्या विश्वविलक्षणा ।
एकानेकस्य रूपेण भाति भानोरिव प्रभा ॥

7.2.s:
anantāḥ śaktayo yasyā icchājñānakriyādayaḥ |
māyādyāścābhavanvahnorvisphuliṅgā yathā tathā ||
7.2.d:
अनन्ताः शक्तयो यस्या इच्छाज्ञानक्रियादयः ।
मायाद्याश्चाभवन्वह्नोर्विस्फुलिङ्गा यथा तथा ॥

7.2.s:
sadāśiveśvarādyā hi vidyāvidyeśvarādayaḥ |
abhavan puruṣāścāsyāḥ prakṛtiśca parātparā ||
7.2.d:
सदाशिवेश्वराद्या हि विद्याविद्येश्वरादयः ।
अभवन् पुरुषाश्चास्याः प्रकृतिश्च परात्परा ॥

7.2.s:
mahadādiviśeṣāntāstvajādyāścāpi mūrtayaḥ |
yaccānyadasti tatsarvaṃ tasyāḥ kāryaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
7.2.d:
महदादिविशेषान्तास्त्वजाद्याश्चापि मूर्तयः ।
यच्चान्यदस्ति तत्सर्वं तस्याः कार्यं न संशयः ॥
7.2.m: Whatever else exists, all that is its effect; there is no doubt. / That power is all-pervading, subtle, whose nature is awakening and bliss.

7.2.s:
sā śaktiḥ sarvagā sūkṣmā prabodhānandarūpiṇī |
śaktimānucyate devaḥ śivaḥ śītāṃśubhūṣaṇaḥ ||
7.2.d:
सा शक्तिः सर्वगा सूक्ष्मा प्रबोधानन्दरूपिणी ।
शक्तिमानुच्यते देवः शिवः शीतांशुभूषणः ॥

7.2.s:
vedyaḥ śivaḥ śivā vidyā prajñā caiva śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ |
dhṛtireṣā sthitirniṣṭhā jñānecchākarmaśaktayaḥ ||
7.2.d:
वेद्यः शिवः शिवा विद्या प्रज्ञा चैव श्रुतिः स्मृतिः ।
धृतिरेषा स्थितिर्निष्ठा ज्ञानेच्छाकर्मशक्तयः ॥
7.2.m: it is steadfastness, continuance, commitment, and the powers of knowledge, will, and action; / it is the sovereign command, the supreme Brahman, and the two kinds of knowledge, higher and lower.

7.2.s:
ājñā caiva paraṃ brahma dve vidye ca parāpare |
śuddhavidyā śuddhakalā sarvaṃ śaktikṛtaṃ yataḥ ||
7.2.d:
आज्ञा चैव परं ब्रह्म द्वे विद्ये च परापरे ।
शुद्धविद्या शुद्धकला सर्वं शक्तिकृतं यतः ॥
7.2.m: It is Śuddhavidyā and Śuddhakalā, since everything is produced by the power. / Māyā, prakṛti, the individual soul, modification, and transform,

7.2.s:
māyā ca prakṛtirjīvo vikāro vikṛtistathā |
asacca sacca yatkiñcittayā sarvamidaṃ tatam ||
7.2.d:
माया च प्रकृतिर्जीवो विकारो विकृतिस्तथा ।
असच्च सच्च यत्किञ्चित्तया सर्वमिदं ततम् ॥

7.2.s:
sā devī māyayā sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram |
mohayatyaprayatnena mocayatyapi līlayā ||
7.2.d:
सा देवी मायया सर्वं ब्रह्माण्डं सचराचरम् ।
मोहयत्यप्रयत्नेन मोचयत्यपि लीलया ॥

7.2.s:
anayā saha sarveśaḥ saptaviṃśaprakārayā |
viśvaṃ vyāpya sthitastasmāt muktiratra pravartate ||
7.2.d:
अनया सह सर्वेशः सप्तविंशप्रकारया ।
विश्वं व्याप्य स्थितस्तस्मात् मुक्तिरत्र प्रवर्तते ॥

7.2.s:
mumukṣavaḥ purā kecinmunayo brahmavādinaḥ |
saṃśayāviṣṭamanaso vismṛśanti yathātatham ||
7.2.d:
मुमुक्षवः पुरा केचिन्मुनयो ब्रह्मवादिनः ।
संशयाविष्टमनसो विस्मृशन्ति यथातथम् ॥

7.2.s:
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ kuto jātā jīvāmaḥ kena vā vayam |
kutrāsmākaṃ sampratiṣṭhā kena vādhiṣṭhitā vayam ||
7.2.d:
किं कारणं कुतो जाता जीवामः केन वा वयम् ।
कुत्रास्माकं सम्प्रतिष्ठा केन वाधिष्ठिता वयम् ॥
7.2.m: 'What is the cause? Whence are we born? By what do we live? / Where is our resting place? By whom are we presided over?

7.2.s:
kena vartāmahe śaśvatsukheṣvanyeṣu cāniśam |
avilaṅghyā ca viśvasya vyavasthā kena vā kṛtā ||
7.2.d:
केन वर्तामहे शश्वत्सुखेष्वन्येषु चानिशम् ।
अविलङ्घ्या च विश्वस्य व्यवस्था केन वा कृता ॥
7.2.m: By whom do we constantly exist in pleasures and day and night in other [experiences]? / And by whom was this inviolable order of the universe established?

7.2.s:
kālasya bhāvo niyatiryadṛcchā nātra yujyate |
bhūtāni yoniḥ puruṣo yogī caiṣāṃ paro'thavā ||
7.2.d:
कालस्य भावो नियतिर्यदृच्छा नात्र युज्यते ।
भूतानि योनिः पुरुषो योगी चैषां परोऽथवा ॥
7.2.m: The nature of time, destiny, or chance cannot be proper [causes] here; / nor the elements, the womb, the Puruṣa, or a combination of these, or something beyond them.

7.2.s:
acetanatvātkālādeścetanatve'pi cātmanaḥ |
sukhaduḥkhāni bhūtatvādanīśatvādvicāryate ||
7.2.d:
अचेतनत्वात्कालादेश्चेतनत्वेऽपि चात्मनः ।
सुखदुःखानि भूतत्वादनीशत्वाद्विचार्यते ॥
7.2.m: Because time and the rest are insentient, and although the soul is sentient, / it experiences pleasures and pains, being subject to them and not being the master—this is under consideration.'

7.2.s:
taddhyānayogānugatāḥ prapaśyan śaktimaiśvarīm |
pāśavicchedikāṃ sākṣānnigūḍhāṃ svaguṇairbhṛśam ||
7.2.d:
तद्ध्यानयोगानुगताः प्रपश्यन् शक्तिमैश्वरीम् ।
पाशविच्छेदिकां साक्षान्निगूढां स्वगुणैर्भृशम् ॥
7.2.m: Engaged in the yoga of meditation on him, they beheld the divine power, / which severs the fetters directly, hidden deeply by its own qualities.

7.2.s:
tayā vicchinnapāśāste sarvakāraṇakāraṇam |
śaktimantaṃ mahādevamapaśyandivyacakṣuṣā ||
7.2.d:
तया विच्छिन्नपाशास्ते सर्वकारणकारणम् ।
शक्तिमन्तं महादेवमपश्यन्दिव्यचक्षुषा ॥
7.2.m: Their fetters severed by her, they saw with divine sight / the Possessor of Power, Mahādeva, the cause of all causes,

7.2.s:
yaḥ kāraṇānyaśeṣāṇi kālātmasahitāni ca |
aprameyo'nayā śaktyā sakalaṃ yo'dhitiṣṭhati ||
7.2.d:
यः कारणान्यशेषाणि कालात्मसहितानि च ।
अप्रमेयोऽनया शक्त्या सकलं योऽधितिष्ठति ॥
7.2.m: who, immeasurable, presides over all causes / along with time and souls, over everything, by means of this power.

7.2.s:
tataḥ prasādayogena yogena parameṇa ca |
dṛṣṭena bhaktiyogena divyāṃ gatimavāpnuyuḥ ||
7.2.d:
ततः प्रसादयोगेन योगेन परमेण च ।
दृष्टेन भक्तियोगेन दिव्यां गतिमवाप्नुयुः ॥
7.2.m: Then, through the conjunction of grace and through the supreme yoga, / seen through the yoga of devotion, they attain the divine state.

7.2.s:
tasmātsaha tathā śaktyā hṛdi paśyanti ye śivam |
teṣāṃ śāśvatikī śāntirnaitareṣāmiti śrutiḥ ||
7.2.d:
तस्मात्सह तथा शक्त्या हृदि पश्यन्ति ये शिवम् ।
तेषां शाश्वतिकी शान्तिर्नैतरेषामिति श्रुतिः ॥
7.2.m: Therefore, those who behold Śiva together with [His] Śakti in their hearts, / to them belongs eternal peace, not to others—such is the scripture.

7.2.s:
na hi śaktimataḥ śaktyā viprayogo'sti jātucit |
tasmāt śakteḥ śaktimatastādātmyānnirvṛtirdvayoḥ ||
7.2.d:
न हि शक्तिमतः शक्त्या विप्रयोगोऽस्ति जातुचित् ।
तस्मात् शक्तेः शक्तिमतस्तादात्म्यान्निर्वृतिर्द्वयोः ॥
7.2.m: Indeed, there is never any separation of the possessor of power from [His] Śakti; / therefore, through identity of the Śakti and the possessor of power, there is bliss for both.

7.2.s:
kramo vivakṣito nūnaṃ vimuktau jñānakarmaṇoḥ |
prasāde sati sā mūrtiryasmātkaratale sthitā ||
7.2.d:
क्रमो विवक्षितो नूनं विमुक्तौ ज्ञानकर्मणोः ।
प्रसादे सति सा मूर्तिर्यस्मात्करतले स्थिता ॥
7.2.m: A gradation is indeed intended in the liberation of knowledge and action, / since, when grace is present, that form stands in the palm of one's hand.

7.2.s:
devo vā dānavo vāpi paśurvā vihago'pi vā |
kīro vātha kṛmirvāpi mucyate tatprasādataḥ ||
7.2.d:
देवो वा दानवो वापि पशुर्वा विहगोऽपि वा ।
कीरो वाथ कृमिर्वापि मुच्यते तत्प्रसादतः ॥
7.2.m: Whether a god or a demon, a beast or a bird, / a parrot or an insect, one is liberated through His grace.

7.2.s:
garbhastho jāyamāno vā bālo vā taruṇo'pi vā |
vṛddho vā mriyamāṇo vā svargastho vātha nārakī ||
7.2.d:
गर्भस्थो जायमानो वा बालो वा तरुणोऽपि वा ।
वृद्धो वा म्रियमाणो वा स्वर्गस्थो वाथ नारकी ॥
7.2.m: Whether in the womb or being born, a child or a youth, / an old man or dying, in heaven or an inhabitant of hell,

7.2.s:
patito vāpi dharmātmā paṇḍito mūḍha eva vā |
prasāde tatkṣaṇādeva mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
7.2.d:
पतितो वापि धर्मात्मा पण्डितो मूढ एव वा ।
प्रसादे तत्क्षणादेव मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥
7.2.m: whether fallen or righteous, learned or foolish— / upon [receiving His] grace, one is instantly liberated; there is no doubt about this.

7.2.s:
ayogyānāṃ ca kāruṇyādbhaktānāṃ parameśvaraḥ |
prasīdati na sandeho vigṛhya vividhān malān ||
7.2.d:
अयोग्यानां च कारुण्याद्भक्तानां परमेश्वरः ।
प्रसीदति न सन्देहो विगृह्य विविधान् मलान् ॥
7.2.m: Out of compassion even for the unworthy, Parameśvara is pleased / with His devotees, checking their various impurities; of this there is no doubt.

7.2.s:
prasadādeva sā bhaktiḥ prasādo bhaktisambhavaḥ |
avasthābhedamutprekṣya vidvāṃstatra na muhyati ||
7.2.d:
प्रसदादेव सा भक्तिः प्रसादो भक्तिसम्भवः ।
अवस्थाभेदमुत्प्रेक्ष्य विद्वांस्तत्र न मुह्यति ॥
7.2.m: That devotion arises from grace alone, and grace is born of devotion; / discerning the distinction of stages, the wise person is not bewildered therein.

7.2.s:
prasādapūrvikā yeyaṃ bhuktimuktividhāyinī |
naiva sā śakyate prāptuṃ narairekena janmanā ||
7.2.d:
प्रसादपूर्विका येयं भुक्तिमुक्तिविधायिनी ।
नैव सा शक्यते प्राप्तुं नरैरेकेन जन्मना ॥
7.2.m: This [devotion], preceded by grace, which bestows enjoyment and liberation, / cannot be attained by men in a single birth.

7.2.s:
anekajanmasiddhānāṃ śrautasmārtānuvartinām |
viraktānāṃ prabuddhānāṃ prasīdati maheśvaraḥ ||
7.2.d:
अनेकजन्मसिद्धानां श्रौतस्मार्तानुवर्तिनाम् ।
विरक्तानां प्रबुद्धानां प्रसीदति महेश्वरः ॥
7.2.m: With those perfected through many births, who follow the Vedic and traditional codes, / who are detached and awakened, Maheśvara is pleased.

7.2.s:
prasanne sati deveśe paśau tasmin pravartate |
asti nātho mametyalpā bhaktirbuddhipuraḥsarā ||
7.2.d:
प्रसन्ने सति देवेशे पशौ तस्मिन् प्रवर्तते ।
अस्ति नाथो ममेत्यल्पा भक्तिर्बुद्धिपुरःसरा ॥
7.2.m: When the Lord of Gods is pleased, in that bound soul there arises / a slight devotion preceded by intellect: “I have a Lord.”

7.2.s:
tapasā vividhaiḥ śaivairdharmaiḥ saṃyujyate naraḥ |
tattrayoge tadabhyāsastato bhaktiḥ parā bhavet ||
7.2.d:
तपसा विविधैः शैवैर्धर्मैः संयुज्यते नरः ।
तत्त्रयोगे तदभ्यासस्ततो भक्तिः परा भवेत् ॥
7.2.m: Through austerity, a man is united with various duties sacred to Śiva; / when united with those three, practice of them [begins], and from that supreme devotion arises.

7.2.s:
parayā ca tayā bhaktyā prasādo labhyate paraḥ |
prasādātsarvapāśebhyo muktirmuktasya nirvṛtiḥ ||
7.2.d:
परया च तया भक्त्या प्रसादो लभ्यते परः ।
प्रसादात्सर्वपाशेभ्यो मुक्तिर्मुक्तस्य निर्वृतिः ॥
7.2.m: And through that supreme devotion, supreme grace is obtained; / from grace comes liberation from all fetters, and bliss for the liberated one.

7.2.s:
alpabhāvo'pi yo martyaḥ so'pi janmatrayātparam |
na yoniyantrapīḍāyai bhavennaivātra saṃśayaḥ ||
7.2.d:
अल्पभावोऽपि यो मर्त्यः सोऽपि जन्मत्रयात्परम् ।
न योनियन्त्रपीडायै भवेन्नैवात्र संशयः ॥
7.2.m: Even that mortal who has but little [devotion], even he, after three births, / will not be subject to the torment of the mechanical wheel of the womb; there is no doubt about this.

7.2.s:
sāṅgānaṅgā ca yā sevā sā bhaktiriti kathyate |
sā punarbhidyate tredhā manovākkāyasādhanaiḥ ||
7.2.d:
साङ्गानङ्गा च या सेवा सा भक्तिरिति कथ्यते ।
सा पुनर्भिद्यते त्रेधा मनोवाक्कायसाधनैः ॥
7.2.m: Service, both with limbs and without limbs, is called devotion; / that, in turn, is divided threefold by the means of mind, speech, and body.

7.2.s:
śivarūpādicintā yā sā sevā mānasī smṛtā |
japādirvācikī sevā karmapūjādi kāyikī ||
7.2.d:
शिवरूपादिचिन्ता या सा सेवा मानसी स्मृता ।
जपादिर्वाचिकी सेवा कर्मपूजादि कायिकी ॥
7.2.m: Contemplation of Śiva's form and the like is considered mental service; / recitation and the like is vocal service, while action, worship, and the like is bodily.

7.2.s:
seyaṃ trisādhanā sevā śivadharmaśca kathyate |
sa tu pañcavidhaḥ proktaḥ śivena paramātmanā ||
7.2.d:
सेयं त्रिसाधना सेवा शिवधर्मश्च कथ्यते ।
स तु पञ्चविधः प्रोक्तः शिवेन परमात्मना ॥
7.2.m: This service with three means is called Śiva's duty; / it has been declared fivefold by Śiva, the Supreme Self:

7.2.s:
tapaḥ karma japo dhyānaṃ jñānaṃ ceti samāsataḥ |
karma liṅgārcanādyaṃ ca tapaścāndrāyaṇādikam ||
7.2.d:
तपः कर्म जपो ध्यानं ज्ञानं चेति समासतः ।
कर्म लिङ्गार्चनाद्यं च तपश्चान्द्रायणादिकम् ॥
7.2.m: In brief, [it is] austerity, action, recitation, meditation, and knowledge; / action begins with worship of the liṅga, and austerity is the cāndrāyaṇa fast and the like.

7.2.s:
japastridhā śivābhyāsaścintā dhyānaṃ śivasya tu |
śivāgamoktaṃ yajjñānaṃ tadatra jñānamucyate ||
7.2.d:
जपस्त्रिधा शिवाभ्यासश्चिन्ता ध्यानं शिवस्य तु ।
शिवागमोक्तं यज्ज्ञानं तदत्र ज्ञानमुच्यते ॥
7.2.m: Recitation is threefold; the repetition of Śiva['s name] and contemplation is meditation on Śiva; / and the knowledge declared in the Śaiva scriptures is here called knowledge.

7.2.s:
śrīkaṇṭhena śivenoktaṃ śivāyai ca śivāgamaḥ |
śivāśritānāṃ kāruṇyācchreyasāmekasādhanam ||
7.2.d:
श्रीकण्ठेन शिवेनोक्तं शिवायै च शिवागमः ।
शिवाश्रितानां कारुण्याच्छ्रेयसामेकसाधनम् ॥
7.2.m: The Śaiva scripture was spoken by Śrīkaṇṭha Śiva to Śivā, / as the sole means of the highest good, out of compassion for those who have taken refuge in Śiva.

7.2.s:
tasmādvivardhayedbhaktiṃ śive paramakāraṇe |
tyajecca viṣayāsaṅgaṃ śreyo'rthī matimānnaraḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
7.2.d:
तस्माद्विवर्धयेद्भक्तिं शिवे परमकारणे ।
त्यजेच्च विषयासङ्गं श्रेयोऽर्थी मतिमान्नरः ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
7.2.m:
Therefore, a wise man desiring the highest good should increase his devotion / to Śiva, the supreme cause, and renounce attachment to sense objects.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

7.2.s:
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
bhagavan śrotumicchāmi śivena paribhāṣitam |
vedasāraṃ śivajñānaṃ svāśritānāṃ vimuktaye ||
7.2.d:
कृष्ण उवाच ।
भगवन् श्रोतुमिच्छामि शिवेन परिभाषितम् ।
वेदसारं शिवज्ञानं स्वाश्रितानां विमुक्तये ॥

7.2.s:
abhaktānāmabuddhīnāmayuktānāmagocaram |
arthairdaśardhaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ gūḍhamaprājñaninditam ||
7.2.d:
अभक्तानामबुद्धीनामयुक्तानामगोचरम् ।
अर्थैर्दशर्धैः संयुक्तं गूढमप्राज्ञनिन्दितम् ॥
7.2.m:
endowed with five goals, secret, reviled by the unwise,
contrary to the duties established by class and stage of life, [yet] sometimes identical,

7.2.s:
varṇāśramakṛtairdharmairviparītaṃ kvacitsamam |
vedāt ṣaḍaṅgāduddhṛtya sāṅkhyādyogācca kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
7.2.d:
वर्णाश्रमकृतैर्धर्मैर्विपरीतं क्वचित्समम् ।
वेदात् षडङ्गादुद्धृत्य साङ्ख्याद्योगाच्च कृत्स्नशः ॥

7.2.s:
śatakoṭipramāṇena vistīrṇaṃ granthasaṅkhyayā |
kathitaṃ parameśena tatra pūjā kathaṃ prabhoḥ ||
7.2.d:
शतकोटिप्रमाणेन विस्तीर्णं ग्रन्थसङ्ख्यया ।
कथितं परमेशेन तत्र पूजा कथं प्रभोः ॥
7.2.m:
spoken by the Supreme Lord. How is the worship of the Lord conducted therein?
Who has eligibility in worship and the like, and of what nature are knowledge, yoga, and the rest?

7.2.s:
kasyādhikāraḥ pūjādau jñānayogādayaḥ katham |
tatsarvaṃ vistarādeva vaktumarhasi suvrata ||
7.2.d:
कस्याधिकारः पूजादौ ज्ञानयोगादयः कथम् ।
तत्सर्वं विस्तरादेव वक्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत ॥

7.2.s:
upamanyuruvāca |
śaivaṃ saṅkṣipya vedoktaṃ śivena paribhāṣitam |
stutinindādirahitaṃ sadyaḥ pratyayakārakam ||
7.2.d:
उपमन्युरुवाच ।
शैवं सङ्क्षिप्य वेदोक्तं शिवेन परिभाषितम् ।
स्तुतिनिन्दादिरहितं सद्यः प्रत्ययकारकम् ॥

7.2.s:
guruprasādajaṃ divyamanāyāsena muktidam |
kathayiṣye samāsena tasya śakyo na vistaraḥ ||
7.2.d:
गुरुप्रसादजं दिव्यमनायासेन मुक्तिदम् ।
कथयिष्ये समासेन तस्य शक्यो न विस्तरः ॥

7.2.s:
sisṛkṣayā purāvyaktācchivaḥ sthāṇurmaheśvaraḥ |
satkāryakāraṇopetaḥ svayamāvirabhūtprabhuḥ ||
7.2.d:
सिसृक्षया पुराव्यक्ताच्छिवः स्थाणुर्महेश्वरः ।
सत्कार्यकारणोपेतः स्वयमाविरभूत्प्रभुः ॥
7.2.m:
I shall relate it in brief, for its full extent cannot be told.
Anciently, with the desire to create, from the unmanifest, Śiva, the immovable Great Lord,

7.2.s:
janayāmāsa ca tadā ṛṣirviśvādhikaḥ prabhuḥ |
devānāṃ prathamaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatim ||
7.2.d:
जनयामास च तदा ऋषिर्विश्वाधिकः प्रभुः ।
देवानां प्रथमं देवं ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिम् ॥
7.2.m:
generated the first god of the gods, Brahmā, the lord of prayer.
Brahmā too looked upon the god, his father, as he was being born;

7.2.s:
brahmāpi pitaraṃ devaṃ jāyamānaṃ nyavaikṣata |
taṃ jāyamānaṃ janako devaḥ prāpaśyadājñayā ||
7.2.d:
ब्रह्मापि पितरं देवं जायमानं न्यवैक्षत ।
तं जायमानं जनको देवः प्रापश्यदाज्ञया ॥

7.2.s:
dṛṣṭo rudreṇa devo'sāvasṛjadviśvamīśvaraḥ |
varṇāśramavyavasthāṃ ca cakāra sa pṛthak pṛthak ||
7.2.d:
दृष्टो रुद्रेण देवोऽसावसृजद्विश्वमीश्वरः ।
वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्थां च चकार स पृथक् पृथक् ॥
7.2.m:
and he established the system of classes and stages of life, each separately.
He created Soma for the sake of sacrifice; from Soma the sky arose,

7.2.s:
somaṃ sasarja yajñārthe somād ghauḥ samajāyata |
dharā ca vahniḥ sūryaśca yajño viṣṇuḥ śacīpatiḥ ||
7.2.d:
सोमं ससर्ज यज्ञार्थे सोमाद् घौः समजायत ।
धरा च वह्निः सूर्यश्च यज्ञो विष्णुः शचीपतिः ॥

7.2.s:
te cānye ca surā rudraṃ rudrādhyāyena tuṣṭuvuḥ |
prasannavadanastasthau devānāmagrataḥ prabhuḥ ||
7.2.d:
ते चान्ये च सुरा रुद्रं रुद्राध्यायेन तुष्टुवुः ।
प्रसन्नवदनस्तस्थौ देवानामग्रतः प्रभुः ॥
7.2.m: They and other gods praised Rudra with the Rudrādhyāya; / with a gracious countenance, the Lord stood before the gods.

7.2.s:
apahṛtya svalīlārthaṃ teṣāṃ jñānaṃ maheśvaraḥ |
tamapṛcchaṃstato devāḥ ko bhavāniti mohitāḥ ||
7.2.d:
अपहृत्य स्वलीलार्थं तेषां ज्ञानं महेश्वरः ।
तमपृच्छंस्ततो देवाः को भवानिति मोहिताः ॥
7.2.m: Taking away their knowledge for His own sport, Maheśvara [deluded them]; / then the gods, bewildered, asked Him, “Who are you?”

7.2.s:
so'bravīdbhagavān rudro hyahamekaḥ purātanaḥ |
āsaṃ prathamamevāhaṃ vartāmi ca surottamāḥ ||
7.2.d:
सोऽब्रवीद्भगवान् रुद्रो ह्यहमेकः पुरातनः ।
आसं प्रथममेवाहं वर्तामि च सुरोत्तमाः ॥
7.2.m:
The blessed lord Rudra said, "Indeed, I alone am the ancient one.
I existed at the very beginning, and I exist now, O best of gods,

7.2.s:
bhaviṣyāmi ca matto'nyo vyatirikto na kaścana |
ahameva jagat sarvaṃ tarpayāmi svatejasā ||
7.2.d:
भविष्यामि च मत्तोऽन्यो व्यतिरिक्तो न कश्चन ।
अहमेव जगत् सर्वं तर्पयामि स्वतेजसा ॥
7.2.m: and I will exist; there is none other distinct from me.

7.2.s:
matto'dhikaḥ samo nāsti māṃ yo veda sa mucyate |
ityuktvā bhagavān rudrastatraivāntaradhatta saḥ ||
7.2.d:
मत्तोऽधिकः समो नास्ति मां यो वेद स मुच्यते ।
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् रुद्रस्तत्रैवान्तरधत्त सः ॥

7.2.s:
apaśyantastamīśānaṃ stuvantaścaiva sāmabhiḥ |
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ kṛtvā tvatharvaśirasi sthitam ||
7.2.d:
अपश्यन्तस्तमीशानं स्तुवन्तश्चैव सामभिः ।
व्रतं पाशुपतं कृत्वा त्वथर्वशिरसि स्थितम् ॥
7.2.m:
Having spoken thus, the blessed lord Rudra vanished right there.
Unable to see that Īśāna, and praising him with sāmans,
and undertaking the Pāśupata vow established in the Atharvaśiras,

7.2.s:
bhasmasañchannasarvāṅgā babhūvuramarāstadā |
atha teṣāṃ prasādārthaṃ paśūnāṃ patirīśvaraḥ ||
7.2.d:
भस्मसञ्छन्नसर्वाङ्गा बभूवुरमरास्तदा ।
अथ तेषां प्रसादार्थं पशूनां पतिरीश्वरः ॥
7.2.m:
the immortals then had all their limbs covered with ash.
Then, for the sake of bestowing grace upon them, the lord, the Lord of Bound Creatures,

7.2.s:
sagaṇaścomayā sārdhaṃ sānnidhyamakarotprabhuḥ |
yaṃ vinidrā jitaśvāsā yogino dagdhakilbiṣāḥ ||
7.2.d:
सगणश्चोमया सार्धं सान्निध्यमकरोत्प्रभुः ।
यं विनिद्रा जितश्वासा योगिनो दग्धकिल्बिषाः ॥
7.2.m: together with his retinue and accompanied by Umā, made his presence manifest.

7.2.s:
hṛdi paśyanti taṃ devaṃ dadṛśurdevapuṅgavāḥ |
yāmāhuḥ paramāṃ śaktimīśvarecchānuvartinīm ||
7.2.d:
हृदि पश्यन्ति तं देवं ददृशुर्देवपुङ्गवाः ।
यामाहुः परमां शक्तिमीश्वरेच्छानुवर्तिनीम् ॥
7.2.m:
Her whom they call the supreme Power complying with the lord's will—
they saw that fair-eyed one on the left of Maheśa.

7.2.s:
tāmapaśyan maheśasya vāmato vāmalocanām |
ye vinirdhūtasaṃsārāḥ prāptāḥ śaivaṃ paraṃ padam ||
7.2.d:
तामपश्यन् महेशस्य वामतो वामलोचनाम् ।
ये विनिर्धूतसंसाराः प्राप्ताः शैवं परं पदम् ॥
7.2.m:
Those who have shaken off saṃsāra and attained the supreme Śaiva state,
and those who are eternally perfected, or others—those lords of Gaṇas were also seen.

7.2.s:
nityasiddhāśca ye vānye te ca dṛṣṭā gaṇeśvarāḥ |
atha taṃ tuṣṭuvurdevā devyā saha maheśvaram ||
7.2.d:
नित्यसिद्धाश्च ये वान्ये ते च दृष्टा गणेश्वराः ।
अथ तं तुष्टुवुर्देवा देव्या सह महेश्वरम् ॥

7.2.s:
stotrairmāheśvarairdivyaiḥ śrotaiḥ paurāṇikairapi |
devo'pi devānālokya ghṛṇayā vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ||
7.2.d:
स्तोत्रैर्माहेश्वरैर्दिव्यैः श्रोतैः पौराणिकैरपि ।
देवोऽपि देवानालोक्य घृणया वृषभध्वजः ॥
7.2.m:
Then the gods praised that Maheśvara together with the goddess
with divine hymns to Maheśvara, both Vedic and Puranic.

7.2.s:
tuṣṭo'smītyāha suprītaḥ svabhāvamadhurāṃ giram |
atha suprītamanasaṃ praṇipatya vṛṣadhvajam |
arthamahattamaṃ devāḥ papracchurimamādarāt ||
7.2.d:
तुष्टोऽस्मीत्याह सुप्रीतः स्वभावमधुरां गिरम् ।
अथ सुप्रीतमनसं प्रणिपत्य वृषध्वजम् ।
अर्थमहत्तमं देवाः पप्रच्छुरिममादरात् ॥
7.2.m:
Then, having bowed to the bull-emblemed one whose mind was highly pleased,
the gods respectfully asked him about this most supreme matter:
The gods said:
"O blessed lord, by which path are you to be worshipped on the surface of the earth?

7.2.s:
devā ūcuḥ |
bhagavan kena mārgeṇa pūjanīyo'si bhūtale |
kasyādhikāraḥ pūjāyāṃ vaktumarhasi tattvataḥ ||
7.2.d:
देवा ऊचुः ।
भगवन् केन मार्गेण पूजनीयोऽसि भूतले ।
कस्याधिकारः पूजायां वक्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वतः ॥
7.2.m:
Who has the authority in worship? You ought to tell this in truth."
Then, looking at the goddess with a smile, Hara, the best among gods,

7.2.s:
tataḥ sasmitamālokya devīṃ devavaro haraḥ |
svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa ghoraṃ sūryātmakaṃ param ||
7.2.d:
ततः सस्मितमालोक्य देवीं देववरो हरः ।
स्वरूपं दर्शयामास घोरं सूर्यात्मकं परम् ॥
7.2.m:
revealed his terrifying, supreme form consisting of the sun,
endowed with all the qualities of sovereignty, supreme, made of all splendor,

7.2.s:
sarvaiśvaryaguṇopetaṃ sarvatejomayaṃ param |
śaktibhirmūrtibhiścāṅgairgrahairdevaiśca saṃvṛtam ||
7.2.d:
सर्वैश्वर्यगुणोपेतं सर्वतेजोमयं परम् ।
शक्तिभिर्मूर्तिभिश्चाङ्गैर्ग्रहैर्देवैश्च संवृतम् ॥

7.2.s:
aṣṭabāhuṃ caturvaktramarddhanārīkamadbhutam |
dṛṣṭvaivamadbhutākāraṃ devā viṣṇupurogamāḥ ||
7.2.d:
अष्टबाहुं चतुर्वक्त्रमर्द्धनारीकमद्भुतम् ।
दृष्ट्वैवमद्भुताकारं देवा विष्णुपुरोगमाः ॥
7.2.m:
Beholding such a wondrous form, the gods preceded by Viṣṇu,
recognizing the god as the sun and the goddess as the moon,

7.2.s:
buddhvā divākaraṃ devaṃ devīṃ caiva niśākaram |
pañcabhūtāni śeṣāṇi tanmayaṃ ca carācaram ||
7.2.d:
बुद्ध्वा दिवाकरं देवं देवीं चैव निशाकरम् ।
पञ्चभूतानि शेषाणि तन्मयं च चराचरम् ॥

7.2.s: evamuktvā namaścakrustasmai cārghyaṃ pradāya vai ||
7.2.d: एवमुक्त्वा नमश्चक्रुस्तस्मै चार्घ्यं प्रदाय वै ॥
7.2.m: having spoken thus, indeed bowed down to him and offered water of honor:

7.2.s:
sindūravarṇāya sumaṇḍalāya suvarṇavarṇābharaṇāya tubhyam |
padmābhanetrāya sapaṅkajāya brahmendranārāyaṇakāraṇāya ||
7.2.d:
सिन्दूरवर्णाय सुमण्डलाय सुवर्णवर्णाभरणाय तुभ्यम् ।
पद्माभनेत्राय सपङ्कजाय ब्रह्मेन्द्रनारायणकारणाय ॥
7.2.m: "To you who have the color of vermilion, possessing an excellent orb, adorned with gold-colored ornaments,

7.2.s:
suratnapūrṇaṃ sasuvarṇatoyaṃ sukuṅkumādyaṃ sakuśaṃ sapuṣpam |
pradattamādāya sahemapātraṃ praśastamarghyaṃ bhagavan prasīda ||
7.2.d:
सुरत्नपूर्णं ससुवर्णतोयं सुकुङ्कुमाद्यं सकुशं सपुष्पम् ।
प्रदत्तमादाय सहेमपात्रं प्रशस्तमर्घ्यं भगवन् प्रसीद ॥

7.2.s:
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya sagaṇāyādihetave |
rudrāya viṣṇave tubhyaṃ brahmaṇe sūryamūrtaye ||
7.2.d:
नमः शिवाय शान्ताय सगणायादिहेतवे ।
रुद्राय विष्णवे तुभ्यं ब्रह्मणे सूर्यमूर्तये ॥
7.2.m: Obeisance to Śiva, the peaceful, accompanied by his attendants, the primal cause, / to Rudra, to Viṣṇu, to Brahmā, to you whose form is the Sun!”

7.2.s:
yaḥ śivaṃ maṇḍale saure sampūjyaiva samāhitaḥ |
prātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne pradadyādarghyamuttamam ||
7.2.d:
यः शिवं मण्डले सौरे सम्पूज्यैव समाहितः ।
प्रातर्मध्याह्नसायाह्ने प्रदद्यादर्घ्यमुत्तमम् ॥
7.2.m: Whoever, having worshipped Śiva in the solar orb with a collected mind, / offers the supreme water of honor in the morning, at noon, and in the evening,

7.2.s:
praṇamedvā paṭhedetān śalokān śrutimukhānimān |
na tasya durllabhaṃ kiñcidbhaktaścenmucyate dṛḍham ||
7.2.d:
प्रणमेद्वा पठेदेतान् शलोकान् श्रुतिमुखानिमान् ।
न तस्य दुर्ल्लभं किञ्चिद्भक्तश्चेन्मुच्यते दृढम् ॥
7.2.m: or bows down or recites these verses that are Vedic utterances, / nothing is hard to obtain for him; if he is devoted, he is firmly liberated.

7.2.s:
tasmādabhyarcayenityaṃ śivamādityarūpiṇam |
dharmakāmārthamuktyarthaṃ manasā karmaṇā girā ||
7.2.d:
तस्मादभ्यर्चयेनित्यं शिवमादित्यरूपिणम् ।
धर्मकामार्थमुक्त्यर्थं मनसा कर्मणा गिरा ॥
7.2.m: “Therefore, worship Śiva daily, who has the form of the Sun, / for the sake of virtue, desire, wealth, and liberation, in thought, action, and speech.”

7.2.s:
atha devān samālokya maṇḍalastho maheśvaraḥ |
sarvāgamottaraṃ dattvā śāstramantaradhāddharaḥ ||
7.2.d:
अथ देवान् समालोक्य मण्डलस्थो महेश्वरः ।
सर्वागमोत्तरं दत्त्वा शास्त्रमन्तरधाद्धरः ॥
7.2.m: Then Maheśvara, standing in the disc, having looked upon the gods / and having delivered the scripture that is superior to all Āgamas, Hara disappeared.

7.2.s:
tatra pūjādhikāro'yaṃ brahmakṣatraviśāmiti |
jñātvā praṇamya deveśaṃ devā jagmuryathāgatam ||
7.2.d:
तत्र पूजाधिकारोऽयं ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशामिति ।
ज्ञात्वा प्रणम्य देवेशं देवा जग्मुर्यथागतम् ॥
7.2.m: Knowing that “this entitlement to worship belongs here to Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, and Vaiśyas,” / and having bowed down to the lord of the gods, the gods departed as they had come.

7.2.s:
atha kālena mahatā tasmin śāstre tirohite |
bhartāraṃ paripapraccha tadaṅkasthā maheśvarī ||
7.2.d:
अथ कालेन महता तस्मिन् शास्त्रे तिरोहिते ।
भर्तारं परिपप्रच्छ तदङ्कस्था महेश्वरी ॥
7.2.m: Then, after a great lapse of time, when that scripture had vanished, / Maheśvarī, seated on his lap, questioned her husband.

7.2.s:
tayā sañcodito devo devyā candravibhūṣaṇaḥ |
avadatkaramuddhṛtya śāstraṃ sarvāgamottaram ||
7.2.d:
तया सञ्चोदितो देवो देव्या चन्द्रविभूषणः ।
अवदत्करमुद्धृत्य शास्त्रं सर्वागमोत्तरम् ॥
7.2.m: Impelled by that goddess, the god adorned with the crescent moon / raised his hand and proclaimed the scripture that is superior to all Āgamas.

7.2.s:
pravartitaṃ ca talloke niyogātparameṣṭhinaḥ |
mayāgastyena guruṇā dadhīcena maharṣiṇā ||
7.2.d:
प्रवर्तितं च तल्लोके नियोगात्परमेष्ठिनः ।
मयागस्त्येन गुरुणा दधीचेन महर्षिणा ॥
7.2.m: And it was propagated in the world by the command of the Supreme Lord / by me, by Agastya the teacher, and by Dadhīca the great sage.

7.2.s:
svayamapyavatīryorvyāṃ yugāvarteṣu śūladhṛk |
svāśritānāṃ vimuktyarthaṃ kurute jñānasantatim ||
7.2.d:
स्वयमप्यवतीर्योर्व्यां युगावर्तेषु शूलधृक् ।
स्वाश्रितानां विमुक्त्यर्थं कुरुते ज्ञानसन्ततिम् ॥
7.2.m: The bearer of the trident himself, descending onto the earth in the revolutions of the yugas, / produces a lineage of knowledge for the liberation of those who take refuge in him.

7.2.s:
ṛbhuḥ satyo bhārgavaśca hyaṅgirāḥ savitā dvijāḥ |
mṛtyuḥ śatakraturdhīmān vasiṣṭho munipuṅgavaḥ ||
7.2.d:
ऋभुः सत्यो भार्गवश्च ह्यङ्गिराः सविता द्विजाः ।
मृत्युः शतक्रतुर्धीमान् वसिष्ठो मुनिपुङ्गवः ॥
7.2.m: Ṛbhu, Satya, Bhārgava, and Aṅgiras, Savitṛ, O twice-born ones, / Mṛtyu, the wise Śatakratu, and Vasiṣṭha, the eminent sage,

7.2.s:
sārasvatastridhāmā ca trivṛto munipuṅgavaḥ |
śatatejāḥ svayaṃ dharmo nārāyaṇa iti śrutaḥ ||
7.2.d:
सारस्वतस्त्रिधामा च त्रिवृतो मुनिपुङ्गवः ।
शततेजाः स्वयं धर्मो नारायण इति श्रुतः ॥
7.2.m: Sārasvata, Tridhāman, and Trivṛta, the eminent sage, / Śatatejas, Dharma himself, and he who is heard of as Nārāyaṇa,

7.2.s:
svarakṣaścāruṇirdhīmāṃstathā caiva kṛtañjayaḥ |
māmateyo bharadvājo gautamaḥ kaviruttamaḥ ||
7.2.d:
स्वरक्षश्चारुणिर्धीमांस्तथा चैव कृतञ्जयः ।
मामतेयो भरद्वाजो गौतमः कविरुत्तमः ॥
7.2.m: Svarakṣa, the wise Āruṇi, and likewise Kṛtañjaya, / Māmateya, Bharadvāja, and Gautama, the supreme poet,

7.2.s:
vācaḥsravā munissākṣāttathā sūkṣmāyaṇiḥ śuciḥ |
tṛṇabindurmuniḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śaktiḥ śākteya uttaraḥ ||
7.2.d:
वाचःस्रवा मुनिस्साक्षात्तथा सूक्ष्मायणिः शुचिः ।
तृणबिन्दुर्मुनिः कृष्णः शक्तिः शाक्तेय उत्तरः ॥
7.2.m: the sage Vācaḥśravas in person, and likewise the pure Sūkṣmāyaṇi, / the sage Tṛṇabindu, Kṛṣṇa, Śakti, and next the son of Śakti,

7.2.s:
jātūkarṇyo hariḥ sākṣāt kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ |
vyāsāvatārān śṛṇvantu kalpayogeśvarān kramāt ||
7.2.d:
जातूकर्ण्यो हरिः साक्षात् कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः ।
व्यासावतारान् शृण्वन्तु कल्पयोगेश्वरान् क्रमात् ॥
7.2.m: Jātūkarṇya, and Hari in person, the sage Kṛṣṇadvaipāyana: / hear the incarnations of Vyāsa, the lords of yoga in the kalpa, in order.

7.2.s:
laiṅge vyāsāvatārā hi dvāparānteṣu suvratāḥ |
yogācāryāvatārāśca tathā śiṣyeṣu śūlinaḥ ||
7.2.d:
लैङ्गे व्यासावतारा हि द्वापरान्तेषु सुव्रताः ।
योगाचार्यावताराश्च तथा शिष्येषु शूलिनः ॥
7.2.m: Indeed, in the Liṅgapurāṇa, the incarnations of Vyāsa at the ends of the Dvāparas are described, O you of good vows, / as well as the incarnations of the bearer of the trident as teachers of yoga among the disciples.

7.2.s:
tatra tatra vibhoḥ śiṣyāścatvāraḥ syurmahaujasaḥ |
śiṣyāsteṣāṃ praśiṣyāśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ||
7.2.d:
तत्र तत्र विभोः शिष्याश्चत्वारः स्युर्महौजसः ।
शिष्यास्तेषां प्रशिष्याश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥
7.2.m: Here and there the omnipresent lord has four disciples of great majesty; / their disciples and grand-disciples are in hundreds and in thousands.

7.2.s:
teṣāṃ sambhāvanālloke śaivājñākaraṇādibhiḥ |
bhāgyavanto vimucyante bhaktyā cātyantabhāvitāḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
7.2.d:
तेषां सम्भावनाल्लोके शैवाज्ञाकरणादिभिः ।
भाग्यवन्तो विमुच्यन्ते भक्त्या चात्यन्तभाविताः ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
7.2.m:
Through revering them in the world, by executing the commands of Śiva and the like, / fortunate people, deeply imbued with devotion, are liberated.

Obeisance to auspicious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

7.2.s:
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
yugāvarteṣu sarveṣu yogācāryacchalena tu |
avatārānhi śarvasya śiṣyāṃśca bhagavan vada ||
7.2.d:
कृष्ण उवाच ।
युगावर्तेषु सर्वेषु योगाचार्यच्छलेन तु ।
अवतारान्हि शर्वस्य शिष्यांश्च भगवन् वद ॥
7.2.m:
Chapter 9
Kṛṣṇa said:
In all the turns of a yuga, under the guise of teachers of yoga,

7.2.s:
upamanyuruvāca |
śvetaḥ sutāro madanaḥ suhotraḥ kaṅka eva ca |
laugākṣiśca mahāmāyo jaigīṣavyastathaiva ca ||
7.2.d:
उपमन्युरुवाच ।
श्वेतः सुतारो मदनः सुहोत्रः कङ्क एव च ।
लौगाक्षिश्च महामायो जैगीषव्यस्तथैव च ॥
7.2.m:
tell of the incarnations of Śarva, O blessed one, and his disciples.

Upamanyu said:
Śveta, Sutāra, Madana, Suhotra, and Kaṅka,
Laugākṣi, Mahāmāya, and likewise Jaigīṣavya,
Dadhivāha, Ṛṣabha, the sage Ugra, and Atri,

7.2.s:
dadhivāhaśca ṛṣabho munirugro'trireva ca |
supālako gautamaśca tathā vedaśirā muniḥ ||
7.2.d:
दधिवाहश्च ऋषभो मुनिरुग्रोऽत्रिरेव च ।
सुपालको गौतमश्च तथा वेदशिरा मुनिः ॥
7.2.m: Supālaka, Gautama, and likewise the sage Vedaśiras,

7.2.s:
gokarṇaśca guhāvāsī śikhaṇḍī cāparaḥ smṛtaḥ |
jaṭāmālī cāṭṭahāso dāruko lāṅgulī tathā ||
7.2.d:
गोकर्णश्च गुहावासी शिखण्डी चापरः स्मृतः ।
जटामाली चाट्टहासो दारुको लाङ्गुली तथा ॥
7.2.m: Gokarṇa, Guhāvāsin, and another remembered as Śikhaṇḍin, / Jaṭāmālin, Aṭṭahāsa, Dāruka, and Lāṅgulin,

7.2.s:
mahākālaśca śūlī ca daṇḍī muṇḍīśa eva ca |
sahiṣṇuḥ somaśarmā ca lakulīśvara eva ca ||
7.2.d:
महाकालश्च शूली च दण्डी मुण्डीश एव च ।
सहिष्णुः सोमशर्मा च लकुलीश्वर एव च ॥
7.2.m: Mahākāla, Śūlin, Daṇḍin, Muṇḍīśa, / Sahiṣṇu, Somaśarman, and Lakulīśvara:

7.2.s:
ete vārāhakalpe'smin saptamasyāntaro manoḥ |
aṣṭāviṃśatisaṅkhyātā yogācāryā yugakramāt ||
7.2.d:
एते वाराहकल्पेऽस्मिन् सप्तमस्यान्तरो मनोः ।
अष्टाविंशतिसङ्ख्याता योगाचार्या युगक्रमात् ॥
7.2.m: these, twenty-eight in number, are the teachers of yoga in this Vārāhakalpa, / within the period of the seventh Manu, in the succession of the yugas.

7.2.s:
śiṣyāḥ pratyekameteṣāṃ catvāraḥ śāntacetasaḥ |
śvetādayaśca ruṣyāntāṃstān bravīmi yathākramam ||
7.2.d:
शिष्याः प्रत्येकमेतेषां चत्वारः शान्तचेतसः ।
श्वेतादयश्च रुष्यान्तांस्तान् ब्रवीमि यथाक्रमम् ॥
7.2.m: Each of these has four disciples of tranquil mind. / I shall name them in their proper order, beginning with Śveta and ending with Ruṣi:

7.2.s:
śvetaḥ śvetaśikhaścaiva śvetāśvaḥ śvetalohitaḥ |
dundubhiḥ śatarūpaśca ṛcīkaḥ ketumāṃstathā ||
7.2.d:
श्वेतः श्वेतशिखश्चैव श्वेताश्वः श्वेतलोहितः ।
दुन्दुभिः शतरूपश्च ऋचीकः केतुमांस्तथा ॥
7.2.m: Śveta, Śvetaśikha, Śvetāśva, Śvetalohita; / Dundubhi, Śatarūpa, Ṛcīka, and Ketumant;

7.2.s:
vikośaśca vikeśaśca vipāśaḥ pāśanāśanaḥ |
sumukho durmukhaścaiva durgamo duratikramaḥ ||
7.2.d:
विकोशश्च विकेशश्च विपाशः पाशनाशनः ।
सुमुखो दुर्मुखश्चैव दुर्गमो दुरतिक्रमः ॥
7.2.m: Vikośa, Vikeśa, Vipāśa, Pāśanāśana; / Sumukha, Durmukha, Durgama, Duratikrama;

7.2.s:
sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanandaśca sanātanaḥ |
sudhāmā virajāścaiva śaṅkhaścāṇḍaja eva ca ||
7.2.d:
सनत्कुमारः सनकः सनन्दश्च सनातनः ।
सुधामा विरजाश्चैव शङ्खश्चाण्डज एव च ॥
7.2.m: Sanatkumāra, Sanaka, Sananda, Sanātana; / Sudhāman, Virajas, Śaṅkha, and Aṇḍaja;

7.2.s:
sārasvataśca meghaśca meghavāhaḥ suvāhakaḥ |
kapilaścāsuriḥ pañcaśikho bāṣkala eva ca ||
7.2.d:
सारस्वतश्च मेघश्च मेघवाहः सुवाहकः ।
कपिलश्चासुरिः पञ्चशिखो बाष्कल एव च ॥
7.2.m: Sārasvata, Megha, Meghavāha, Suvāhaka; / Kapila, Āsuri, Pañcaśikha, and Bāṣkala;

7.2.s:
parāśarāśca gargaśca bhārgavaścāṅgirāstathā |
balabandhurnirāmitrāḥ ketuśṛṅgastapodhanaḥ ||
7.2.d:
पराशराश्च गर्गश्च भार्गवश्चाङ्गिरास्तथा ।
बलबन्धुर्निरामित्राः केतुशृङ्गस्तपोधनः ॥
7.2.m: Parāśara, Garga, Bhārgava, and Aṅgiras; / Balabandhu, Nirāmitra, Ketuśṛṅga the ascetic;

7.2.s:
lambodaraśca lambaśca lambātmā lambakeśakaḥ |
sarvajñaḥ samabuddhiśca sādhyasiddhistathaiva ca ||
7.2.d:
लम्बोदरश्च लम्बश्च लम्बात्मा लम्बकेशकः ।
सर्वज्ञः समबुद्धिश्च साध्यसिद्धिस्तथैव च ॥
7.2.m: Lambodara, Lamba, Lambātman, Lambakeśaka; / Sarvajña, Samabuddhi, and likewise Sādhyasiddhi;

7.2.s:
sudhāmā kaśyapaścaiva vasiṣṭho virajāstathā |
atrirugro guruśreṣṭhaḥ śravano'tha śraviṣṭakaḥ ||
7.2.d:
सुधामा कश्यपश्चैव वसिष्ठो विरजास्तथा ।
अत्रिरुग्रो गुरुश्रेष्ठः श्रवनोऽथ श्रविष्टकः ॥
7.2.m: Sudhāman, Kaśyapa, Vasiṣṭha, and Virajas; / Atri, Ugra, the best guru, Śravaṇa, and Śraviṣṭhaka;

7.2.s:
kuṇiśca kuṇibāhuśca kuśarīraḥ kunetrakaḥ |
kāśyapo hyuśanāścaiva cyavanaśca bṛhaspatiḥ ||
7.2.d:
कुणिश्च कुणिबाहुश्च कुशरीरः कुनेत्रकः ।
काश्यपो ह्युशनाश्चैव च्यवनश्च बृहस्पतिः ॥
7.2.m: Kuṇi, Kuṇibāhu, Kuśarīra, Kunetraka; / Kāśyapa, Uśanas, Cyavana, and Bṛhaspati;

7.2.s:
utathyo vāmadevaśca mahākālo mahānilaḥ |
vācaḥśravāḥ suvīraśca śyāvakaśca yatīśvaraḥ ||
7.2.d:
उतथ्यो वामदेवश्च महाकालो महानिलः ।
वाचःश्रवाः सुवीरश्च श्यावकश्च यतीश्वरः ॥
7.2.m: Utathya, Vāmadeva, Mahākāla, Mahānila; / Vācaḥśravas, Suvīra, Śyāvaka the lord of ascetics;

7.2.s:
hiraṇyanābhaḥ kauśalyo lokākṣiḥ kuthumistathā |
sumanturjaiminiścaiva kubandhaḥ kuśakandharaḥ ||
7.2.d:
हिरण्यनाभः कौशल्यो लोकाक्षिः कुथुमिस्तथा ।
सुमन्तुर्जैमिनिश्चैव कुबन्धः कुशकन्धरः ॥
7.2.m: Hiraṇyanābha, Kauśalya, Lokākṣi, and Kuthumi; / Sumantu, Jaimini, Kubandha, and Kuśakandhara;

7.2.s:
plakṣo dārbhāyaṇiścaiva ketumān gautamastathā |
bhallavī madhupiṅgaśca śvetaketustathaiva ca ||
7.2.d:
प्लक्षो दार्भायणिश्चैव केतुमान् गौतमस्तथा ।
भल्लवी मधुपिङ्गश्च श्वेतकेतुस्तथैव च ॥
7.2.m: Plakṣa, Dārbhāyaṇi, Ketumant, and Gautama; / Bhallavī, Madhupiṅga, and Śvetaketu;

7.2.s:
uśijo bṛhadaśvaśca devalaḥ kavireva ca |
śālihotraḥ suveṣaśca yuvanāśvaḥ śaradvasuḥ ||
7.2.d:
उशिजो बृहदश्वश्च देवलः कविरेव च ।
शालिहोत्रः सुवेषश्च युवनाश्वः शरद्वसुः ॥
7.2.m: Uśij, Bṛhadaśva, Devala, and Kavi; / Śālihotra, Suveṣa, Yuvanāśva, and Śaradvasu;

7.2.s:
akṣapādaḥ kaṇādaśca ulūko vatsa eva ca |
kulikaścaiva gargaśca mitrako ruṣya eva ca ||
7.2.d:
अक्षपादः कणादश्च उलूको वत्स एव च ।
कुलिकश्चैव गर्गश्च मित्रको रुष्य एव च ॥
7.2.m: Akṣapāda, Kaṇāda, Ulūka, and Vatsa; / Kulika, Garga, Mitraka, and Ruṣya.

7.2.s:
ete śiṣyā maheśasya yogācāryasvarūpiṇaḥ |
saṅkhyā ca śatameteṣāṃ saha dvādaśasaṅkhyayā ||
7.2.d:
एते शिष्या महेशस्य योगाचार्यस्वरूपिणः ।
सङ्ख्या च शतमेतेषां सह द्वादशसङ्ख्यया ॥
7.2.m: These are the disciples of Maheśa in the form of teachers of yoga; / and their number is one hundred together with the number twelve.

7.2.s:
sarve pāśupatāḥ siddhā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ |
sarvaśāstrārthatattvajñā vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ ||
7.2.d:
सर्वे पाशुपताः सिद्धा भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहाः ।
सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञा वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः ॥
7.2.m: All were perfected Pāśupatas, their bodies smeared with ashes, / knowers of the truth of all scriptures, masters of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,

7.2.s:
śivāśramaratāḥ sarve śivajñānaparāyaṇāḥ |
sarve saṅgavinirmuktāḥ śivaikāsaktacetasaḥ ||
7.2.d:
शिवाश्रमरताः सर्वे शिवज्ञानपरायणाः ।
सर्वे सङ्गविनिर्मुक्ताः शिवैकासक्तचेतसः ॥
7.2.m: all delighting in the Śaiva stage of life, devoted to the knowledge of Śiva, / completely free from attachment, their minds fixed solely on Śiva,

7.2.s:
sarvadvandvasahā dhīrāḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ |
ṛjavo mṛdavaḥ svasthā jitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ ||
7.2.d:
सर्वद्वन्द्वसहा धीराः सर्वभूतहिते रताः ।
ऋजवो मृदवः स्वस्था जितक्रोधा जितेन्द्रियाः ॥
7.2.m: patient in all pairs of opposites, resolute, devoted to the welfare of all beings, / upright, gentle, composed, having conquered anger and restrained their senses,

7.2.s:
rudrākṣamālābharaṇāstripuṇḍrāṅkitamastakāḥ |
śikhājaṭāḥ sarvajaṭā ajaṭā muṇḍaśīrṣakāḥ ||
7.2.d:
रुद्राक्षमालाभरणास्त्रिपुण्ड्राङ्कितमस्तकाः ।
शिखाजटाः सर्वजटा अजटा मुण्डशीर्षकाः ॥
7.2.m: wearing garlands of rudrākṣas as ornaments, their foreheads marked with the tripuṇḍra, / some with topknots of matted hair, some with all hair matted, some without matted hair, and some with shaved heads,

7.2.s:
phalamūlāśanaprāyāḥ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇāḥ |
śivābhimānasampannāḥ śivadhyānaikatatparāḥ ||
7.2.d:
फलमूलाशनप्रायाः प्राणायामपरायणाः ।
शिवाभिमानसम्पन्नाः शिवध्यानैकतत्पराः ॥
7.2.m: subsisting mostly on fruits and roots, devoted to breath control, / endowed with the pride of belonging to Śiva, intently focused solely on meditating on Śiva,

7.2.s:
samunmathitasaṃsāraviṣavṛkṣāṅkurodgamāḥ |
prayātumeva sannaddhāḥ paraṃ śivapuraṃ prati ||
7.2.d:
समुन्मथितसंसारविषवृक्षाङ्कुरोद्गमाः ।
प्रयातुमेव सन्नद्धाः परं शिवपुरं प्रति ॥
7.2.m: having eradicated the sprouting shoot of the poisonous tree of transmigration, / fully prepared to depart directly toward the supreme abode of Śiva.

7.2.s:
sadeśikānimān matvā nityaṃ yaḥ śivamarcayet |
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
7.2.d:
सदेशिकानिमान् मत्वा नित्यं यः शिवमर्चयेत् ।
स याति शिवसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
7.2.m:
Whoever constantly worships Śiva considering these [masters] together with the preceptors / attains communion with Śiva; no doubt should be entertained on this matter.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

7.2.s:
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
bhagavan sarvayogīndra gaṇeśvara munīśvara |
ṣaḍānanasamaprakhya sarvajñānanidhe guro ||
7.2.d:
कृष्ण उवाच ।
भगवन् सर्वयोगीन्द्र गणेश्वर मुनीश्वर ।
षडाननसमप्रख्य सर्वज्ञाननिधे गुरो ॥

7.2.s:
prāyastvamavatīryorvyāṃ pāśavicchittaye nṛṇām |
maharṣivapurāsthāya sthito'si parameśvara ||
7.2.d:
प्रायस्त्वमवतीर्योर्व्यां पाशविच्छित्तये नृणाम् ।
महर्षिवपुरास्थाय स्थितोऽसि परमेश्वर ॥
7.2.m: equal in fame to the one having six faces, repository of all knowledge, O guru! / You have descended to earth, it seems, to cut away the fetters of men,

7.2.s:
anyathā hi jagatyasmin devo vā dānavo'pi vā |
tvatto'nyaḥ paramaṃ bhāvaṃ ko jānīyāt śivātmakam ||
7.2.d:
अन्यथा हि जगत्यस्मिन् देवो वा दानवोऽपि वा ।
त्वत्तोऽन्यः परमं भावं को जानीयात् शिवात्मकम् ॥

7.2.s:
tasmāttava mukhodgīrṇaṃ sākṣādiva pinākinaḥ |
śivajñānāmṛtaṃ pītvā na me tṛptamabhūnmanaḥ ||
7.2.d:
तस्मात्तव मुखोद्गीर्णं साक्षादिव पिनाकिनः ।
शिवज्ञानामृतं पीत्वा न मे तृप्तमभून्मनः ॥
7.2.m: who other than you could know the supreme state whose nature is Śiva? / Therefore, having drunk the nectar of the knowledge of Śiva,

7.2.s:
sākṣātsarvajagatkarturbharturaṅkaṃ samāśritā |
bhagavankinnu papraccha bhartāraṃ parameśvarī ||
7.2.d:
साक्षात्सर्वजगत्कर्तुर्भर्तुरङ्कं समाश्रिता ।
भगवन्किन्नु पप्रच्छ भर्तारं परमेश्वरी ॥
7.2.m:
what, O blessed one, did the Supreme Mistress ask her husband?
Upamanyu said:
Fitting is that which you have asked, O Kṛṣṇa; I shall relate it as it was,

7.2.s:
upamanyuruvāca |
sthāne pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā kṛṣṇa tadvakṣyāmi yathātatham |
bhavabhaktasya yuktasya tava kalyāṇacetasaḥ ||
7.2.d:
उपमन्युरुवाच ।
स्थाने पृष्टं त्वया कृष्ण तद्वक्ष्यामि यथातथम् ।
भवभक्तस्य युक्तस्य तव कल्याणचेतसः ॥
7.2.m: unto you, a devotee of Bhava, disciplined, whose mind is auspicious. / On the divine, supreme mountain Mandara, in a lovely cave,

7.2.s:
mahīdharavare divye mandare cārukandare |
devyā saha mahādevo divyo dhyānagato'bhavat ||
7.2.d:
महीधरवरे दिव्ये मन्दरे चारुकन्दरे ।
देव्या सह महादेवो दिव्यो ध्यानगतोऽभवत् ॥

7.2.s:
tadā devyāḥ priyasakhī susmitāsyā śubhāvatī |
phullānyatimanojñāni puṣpāṇi samudāharat ||
7.2.d:
तदा देव्याः प्रियसखी सुस्मितास्या शुभावती ।
फुल्लान्यतिमनोज्ञानि पुष्पाणि समुदाहरत् ॥

7.2.s:
tataḥ svamaṅkamāropya devīṃ devavaroharaḥ |
alaṅkṛtya ca taiḥ puṣpairāste hṛṣṭataraḥ svayam ||
7.2.d:
ततः स्वमङ्कमारोप्य देवीं देववरोहरः ।
अलङ्कृत्य च तैः पुष्पैरास्ते हृष्टतरः स्वयम् ॥

7.2.s:
athāntaḥpuracāriṇyo devyo divyavibhūṣaṇāḥ |
antaraṅgā gaṇendrāśca sarvalokamaheśvarīm ||
7.2.d:
अथान्तःपुरचारिण्यो देव्यो दिव्यविभूषणाः ।
अन्तरङ्गा गणेन्द्राश्च सर्वलोकमहेश्वरीम् ॥

7.2.s:
bhartāraṃ paripūrṇaṃ ca sarvalokamaheśvaram |
cāmarāsaktahastāśca devīṃ devaṃ siṣevire ||
7.2.d:
भर्तारं परिपूर्णं च सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् ।
चामरासक्तहस्ताश्च देवीं देवं सिषेविरे ॥
7.2.m: and the intimate lords of gaṇas, attended upon the Supreme Mistress of all worlds / and upon her husband, the complete Supreme Lord of all worlds,

7.2.s:
tataḥ priyāḥ kathā vṛttā vinodāya maheśayoḥ |
trāṇāya ca nṛṇāṃ loke ye śivaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||
7.2.d:
ततः प्रियाः कथा वृत्ता विनोदाय महेशयोः ।
त्राणाय च नृणां लोके ये शिवं शरणं गताः ॥

7.2.s:
tadāvasaramālokya sarvalokamaheśvarī |
bhartāraṃ paripapraccha sarvalokamaheśvaram ||
7.2.d:
तदावसरमालोक्य सर्वलोकमहेश्वरी ।
भर्तारं परिपप्रच्छ सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् ॥
7.2.m:
questioned her husband, the Supreme Lord of all worlds.
The goddess said:
By what means is Mahādeva won over by dull-minded mortals,

7.2.s:
devyuvāca |
kena vaśyo mahādevo martyānāṃ mandacetasām |
ātmatattvādyaśaktānāmātmanāmakṛtātmanām ||
7.2.d:
देव्युवाच ।
केन वश्यो महादेवो मर्त्यानां मन्दचेतसाम् ।
आत्मतत्त्वाद्यशक्तानामात्मनामकृतात्मनाम् ॥

7.2.s:
īśvara uvāca |
na karmaṇā na tapasā na japairnāsanādibhiḥ |
na jñānena na cānyena vaśyo'haṃ śraddhayā vinā ||
7.2.d:
ईश्वर उवाच ।
न कर्मणा न तपसा न जपैर्नासनादिभिः ।
न ज्ञानेन न चान्येन वश्योऽहं श्रद्धया विना ॥
7.2.m:
by those who are incapable of [knowing] the truth of the self, whose minds are undisciplined?
Īśvara said:
Neither by ritual action, nor by asceticism, nor by silent prayers, nor by postures and the like,

7.2.s:
śraddhā mayyasti cetpuṃsāṃ yena kenāpi hetunā |
vaśyaḥ spṛśyaśca dṛśyaśca pūjyassambhāṣya eva ca ||
7.2.d:
श्रद्धा मय्यस्ति चेत्पुंसां येन केनापि हेतुना ।
वश्यः स्पृश्यश्च दृश्यश्च पूज्यस्सम्भाष्य एव च ॥
7.2.m:
nor by knowledge, nor by anything else am I won over, except through faith. / If faith in me is present in men for any reason whatsoever,
I can be won over, touched, seen, worshipped, and even spoken to. / Therefore, faith in me must be cultivated by one who desires to win me over.

7.2.s:
sādhyā tasmān mayi śaddhā māṃ vaśīkartumicchatā |
śraddhā hetuḥ svadharmasya rakṣaṇaṃ varṇināmiha ||
7.2.d:
साध्या तस्मान् मयि शद्धा मां वशीकर्तुमिच्छता ।
श्रद्धा हेतुः स्वधर्मस्य रक्षणं वर्णिनामिह ॥

7.2.s:
svavarṇāśramadharme'tha vartate yastu mānavaḥ |
tasyaiva bhavati śraddhā mayi nānyasya kasyacit ||
7.2.d:
स्ववर्णाश्रमधर्मेऽथ वर्तते यस्तु मानवः ।
तस्यैव भवति श्रद्धा मयि नान्यस्य कस्यचित् ॥
7.2.m: he alone comes to possess faith in me, and no one else. / 554b

7.2.s:
āmnāyasiddhamakhilaṃ dharmamāśramiṇāmiha |
brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ mamaivājñāpuraḥ saram ||
7.2.d:
आम्नायसिद्धमखिलं धर्ममाश्रमिणामिह ।
ब्रह्मणा कथितं पूर्वं ममैवाज्ञापुरः सरम् ॥
7.2.m: All the duty established in the sacred tradition for the members of the stages of life here / was previously taught by Brahmā, preceded by my own command.

7.2.s:
sa tu paitāmaho dharmo bahuvittakriyānvitaḥ |
nātyantaphalabhūyiṣṭhaḥ kleśāyāsasamanvitaḥ |
tena dharmeṇa mahatā śraddhāṃ prāpya sudurllabhām ||
7.2.d:
स तु पैतामहो धर्मो बहुवित्तक्रियान्वितः ।
नात्यन्तफलभूयिष्ठः क्लेशायाससमन्वितः ।
तेन धर्मेण महता श्रद्धां प्राप्य सुदुर्ल्लभाम् ॥
7.2.m: That duty proceeding from the Grandfather, however, involves much wealth and ritual, / does not yield supreme results, and is accompanied by distress and toil. / Having attained very rare faith through that great duty,

7.2.s:
varṇino ye prapadyante māmananyasamāśrayāḥ |
teṣāṃ sukhena mārgeṇa dharmakāmārthamuktayaḥ ||
7.2.d:
वर्णिनो ये प्रपद्यन्ते मामनन्यसमाश्रयाः ।
तेषां सुखेन मार्गेण धर्मकामार्थमुक्तयः ॥
7.2.m: those members of the social classes who take refuge in me, relying on no other, / attain duty, pleasure, wealth, and liberation by an easy path.

7.2.s:
varṇāśramasamācāro mayā bhūyaḥ prakalpitaḥ |
tasmin bhaktimatāmeva madīyānāṃ tu varṇinām ||
7.2.d:
वर्णाश्रमसमाचारो मया भूयः प्रकल्पितः ।
तस्मिन् भक्तिमतामेव मदीयानां तु वर्णिनाम् ॥
7.2.m: The conduct of the classes and stages of life was again established by me; / in that, however, for the members of my classes who possess devotion,

7.2.s:
adhikāro na cānyeṣāmityājñā naiṣṭhikī mama |
tadājñaptena mārgeṇa varṇino madupāśrayāḥ ||
7.2.d:
अधिकारो न चान्येषामित्याज्ञा नैष्ठिकी मम ।
तदाज्ञप्तेन मार्गेण वर्णिनो मदुपाश्रयाः ॥
7.2.m: there is eligibility, and not for others—such is my resolute command. / By the path enjoined by that command, members of the social classes taking refuge in me,

7.2.s:
malamāyādipāśebhyo vimuktā matprasādataḥ |
paraṃ madīyamāsādya punarāvṛttidurlabham |
paramaṃ mama sādharmyaṃ prāpya nirvṛtimāyayuḥ ||
7.2.d:
मलमायादिपाशेभ्यो विमुक्ता मत्प्रसादतः ।
परं मदीयमासाद्य पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् ।
परमं मम साधर्म्यं प्राप्य निर्वृतिमाययुः ॥
7.2.m: freed from the fetters such as impurity and delusion by my grace, / having reached my supreme [abode] where return is rare, / and having attained supreme likeness of nature with me, have achieved bliss.

7.2.s:
tasmāt labdhvāpyalabdhvā vā varṇadharmaṃ mayeritam |
āśritya mama bhaktaścetsvātmanātmānamuddharet ||
7.2.d:
तस्मात् लब्ध्वाप्यलब्ध्वा वा वर्णधर्मं मयेरितम् ।
आश्रित्य मम भक्तश्चेत्स्वात्मनात्मानमुद्धरेत् ॥
7.2.m: Therefore, having obtained or not obtained the duty of the classes taught by me, / if one is my devotee relying [upon it], he should elevate himself by himself.

7.2.s:
alabdhalābha evaiṣa koṭikoṭiguṇādhikaḥ |
tasmānme mukhato labdhaṃ varṇadharmaṃ samācaret ||
7.2.d:
अलब्धलाभ एवैष कोटिकोटिगुणाधिकः ।
तस्मान्मे मुखतो लब्धं वर्णधर्मं समाचरेत् ॥
7.2.m: This is an acquisition of what was not acquired, superior by millions and millions of times; / therefore, one should practice the duty of the classes obtained from my mouth.

7.2.s:
mamāvatārā hi śubhe yogācāryacchalena tu |
sarvāntareṣu santyārye santatiśca sahasraśaḥ ||
7.2.d:
ममावतारा हि शुभे योगाचार्यच्छलेन तु ।
सर्वान्तरेषु सन्त्यार्ये सन्ततिश्च सहस्रशः ॥
7.2.m: For my incarnations under the guise of teachers of yoga, O auspicious one, / are present in all the intermediate periods, O noble one, and their lineages are in the thousands.

7.2.s:
ayuktānāmabuddhīnāmabhaktānāṃ sureśvari |
durlabhaṃ santatijñānaṃ tato yatnātsamāśrayet ||
7.2.d:
अयुक्तानामबुद्धीनामभक्तानां सुरेश्वरि ।
दुर्लभं सन्ततिज्ञानं ततो यत्नात्समाश्रयेत् ॥
7.2.m: For those undisciplined, lacking intellect, and lacking devotion, O ruler of the gods, / the knowledge of the lineages is difficult to attain; therefore, one should resort to it with effort.

7.2.s:
sā hānistanmahacchidraṃ sa mohassāndhamūkatā |
yadanyatra śramaṃ kuryānmokṣamārgabahiṣkṛtaḥ ||
7.2.d:
सा हानिस्तन्महच्छिद्रं स मोहस्सान्धमूकता ।
यदन्यत्र श्रमं कुर्यान्मोक्षमार्गबहिष्कृतः ॥
7.2.m: That is a loss, that is a great flaw, that is delusion, that is blind dumbness— / that one excluded from the path of liberation should labor elsewhere.

7.2.s:
jñānaṃ kriyā ca caryā ca yogaśceti sureśvari |
catuṣpādaḥ samākhyāto mama dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
7.2.d:
ज्ञानं क्रिया च चर्या च योगश्चेति सुरेश्वरि ।
चतुष्पादः समाख्यातो मम धर्मः सनातनः ॥
7.2.m: Knowledge, ritual action, conduct, and yoga, O ruler of the gods— / thus my eternal duty is declared to have four quarters.

7.2.s:
paśupāśapatijñānaṃ jñānamityabhidhīyate |
ṣaḍadhvaśuddhirvidhinā gurvadhīnā kriyocyate ||
7.2.d:
पशुपाशपतिज्ञानं ज्ञानमित्यभिधीयते ।
षडध्वशुद्धिर्विधिना गुर्वधीना क्रियोच्यते ॥
7.2.m: Knowledge of the bound soul, the fetter, and the lord is called 'knowledge'; / the purification of the six pathways according to rule, dependent on the guru, is called 'ritual action'.

7.2.s:
varṇāśramaprayuktasya mayaiva vihitasya ca |
mamārcanādidharmasya caryā caryeti kathyate ||
7.2.d:
वर्णाश्रमप्रयुक्तस्य मयैव विहितस्य च ।
ममार्चनादिधर्मस्य चर्या चर्येति कथ्यते ॥
7.2.m: The observance of the duty of worshipping me and the like, enjoined by me / and applicable to the classes and stages of life, is called 'conduct'.

7.2.s:
maduktenaiva mārgeṇa mayyavasthitacetasaḥ |
vṛttyantaranirodho yo yoga ityabhidhīyate ||
7.2.d:
मदुक्तेनैव मार्गेण मय्यवस्थितचेतसः ।
वृत्त्यन्तरनिरोधो यो योग इत्यभिधीयते ॥
7.2.m: When one's mind rests upon me solely through the path spoken by me, / that suppression of other mental activities is designated as 'yoga'.

7.2.s:
aśvamedhagaṇāt śreṣṭhaṃ devi cittaprasādhanam |
muktidaṃ ca tathā hyetadduṣprāpyaṃ viṣayaiṣiṇām ||
7.2.d:
अश्वमेधगणात् श्रेष्ठं देवि चित्तप्रसाधनम् ।
मुक्तिदं च तथा ह्येतद्दुष्प्राप्यं विषयैषिणाम् ॥
7.2.m: Superior to a multitude of horse sacrifices, O goddess, is the purification of the mind; / and it indeed bestows liberation, yet it is difficult to attain for those pursuing sense objects.

7.2.s:
vijitendriyavargasya yamena niyamena ca |
pūrvapāpaharo yogo viraktasyaiva kathyate ||
7.2.d:
विजितेन्द्रियवर्गस्य यमेन नियमेन च ।
पूर्वपापहरो योगो विरक्तस्यैव कथ्यते ॥
7.2.m: For one who has subdued the group of senses by restraint and observance, / yoga is said to destroy past sins only when one is detached.

7.2.s: vairāgyājjāyate jñānaṃ jñānādyogaḥ pravartate ||
7.2.d: वैराग्याज्जायते ज्ञानं ज्ञानाद्योगः प्रवर्तते ॥
7.2.m: From dispassion arises knowledge; from knowledge, yoga proceeds.

7.2.s:
yogajñaḥ patito vāpi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
dayā kāryātha satatamahiṃsā jñānasaṅgrahaḥ ||
7.2.d:
योगज्ञः पतितो वापि मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ।
दया कार्याथ सततमहिंसा ज्ञानसङ्ग्रहः ॥
7.2.m: One who knows yoga is liberated, even if fallen; there is no doubt in this. / Compassion must be practiced constantly, non-violence, and the acquisition of knowledge,

7.2.s:
satyamasteyamāstikyaṃ śraddhā cendriyanigrahaḥ |
adhyāpanaṃ cādhyayanaṃ yajanaṃ yājanaṃ tathā ||
7.2.d:
सत्यमस्तेयमास्तिक्यं श्रद्धा चेन्द्रियनिग्रहः ।
अध्यापनं चाध्ययनं यजनं याजनं तथा ॥
7.2.m: truth, non-stealing, orthodoxy, faith, restraint of the senses, / teaching, studying, sacrificing, and officiating at sacrifices,

7.2.s:
dhyānamīśvarabhāvaśca satataṃ jñānaśīlatā |
ya evaṃ vartate vipro jñānayogasya siddhaye ||
7.2.d:
ध्यानमीश्वरभावश्च सततं ज्ञानशीलता ।
य एवं वर्तते विप्रो ज्ञानयोगस्य सिद्धये ॥
7.2.m: meditation, devotion to Īśvara, and constant disposition toward knowledge. / The twice-born who acts thus for the attainment of the yoga of knowledge,

7.2.s:
acirādeva vijñānaṃ labdhvā yogaṃ ca vindati |
dagdhvā dehamimaṃ jñānī kṣaṇāt jñānāgninā priye |
prasādānmama yogajñaḥ karmabandhaṃ prahāsyati ||
7.2.d:
अचिरादेव विज्ञानं लब्ध्वा योगं च विन्दति ।
दग्ध्वा देहमिमं ज्ञानी क्षणात् ज्ञानाग्निना प्रिये ।
प्रसादान्मम योगज्ञः कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यति ॥
7.2.m: having obtained discernment before long, also attains yoga. / Burning this body in an instant with the fire of knowledge, O dear one, / the knower of yoga, through my grace, will abandon the bondage of karma.

7.2.s:
puṇyaḥpuṇyātmakaṃ karma muktestatpratibandhakam |
tasmānniyogato yogī puṇyāpuṇyaṃ vivarjayet ||
7.2.d:
पुण्यःपुण्यात्मकं कर्म मुक्तेस्तत्प्रतिबन्धकम् ।
तस्मान्नियोगतो योगी पुण्यापुण्यं विवर्जयेत् ॥
7.2.m: Karma consists of merit and demerit; it is an obstacle to liberation. / Therefore, the yogin must strictly abandon both merit and demerit.

7.2.s:
phalakāmanayā karmakaraṇātpratibadhyate |
na karmamātrakaraṇāttasmātkarmaphalaṃ tyajet ||
7.2.d:
फलकामनया कर्मकरणात्प्रतिबध्यते ।
न कर्ममात्रकरणात्तस्मात्कर्मफलं त्यजेत् ॥
7.2.m: One is bound by performing actions out of desire for fruits, / not merely by performing an action; therefore, one should abandon the fruits of action.

7.2.s:
prathamaṃ karmayajñena bahiḥ sampūjya māṃ priye |
jñānayogarato bhūtvā paścādyogaṃ samabhyaset ||
7.2.d:
प्रथमं कर्मयज्ञेन बहिः सम्पूज्य मां प्रिये ।
ज्ञानयोगरतो भूत्वा पश्चाद्योगं समभ्यसेत् ॥
7.2.m: First having worshipped me externally through the sacrifice of action, O dear one, / and having become intent on the yoga of knowledge, one should afterwards practice yoga.

7.2.s:
vidite mama yāthātmye karmayajñena dehinaḥ |
na yajanti hi māṃ yuktāḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanāḥ ||
7.2.d:
विदिते मम याथात्म्ये कर्मयज्ञेन देहिनः ।
न यजन्ति हि मां युक्ताः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनाः ॥
7.2.m: Indeed, when my true nature is known through the sacrifice of action, embodied beings, / integrated, viewing a clod of earth, a stone, and gold alike, no longer sacrifice to me [externally].

7.2.s:
nityayukto muniḥ śreṣṭho madbhaktaśca samāhitaḥ |
jñānayogarato yogī mama sāyujyamāpnuyāt ||
7.2.d:
नित्ययुक्तो मुनिः श्रेष्ठो मद्भक्तश्च समाहितः ।
ज्ञानयोगरतो योगी मम सायुज्यमाप्नुयात् ॥
7.2.m: Ever-integrated, the excellent sage, devoted to me and concentrated, / the yogin intent on the yoga of knowledge, shall attain communion with me.

7.2.s:
athāviraktacittā ye varṇino madupāśritāḥ |
jñānacaryā kriyāsveva te'dhikuryustadarhakāḥ ||
7.2.d:
अथाविरक्तचित्ता ये वर्णिनो मदुपाश्रिताः ।
ज्ञानचर्या क्रियास्वेव तेऽधिकुर्युस्तदर्हकाः ॥
7.2.m: Now, those members of the classes whose minds are not yet detached, who have resorted to me, / being qualified for that, should undertake the rites and rituals of knowledge alone.

7.2.s:
dvidhā matpūjanaṃ jñeyaṃ bāhyamābhyantaraṃ tathā |
vāṅmanaḥkāyabhedācca tridhā madbhajanaṃ viduḥ ||
7.2.d:
द्विधा मत्पूजनं ज्ञेयं बाह्यमाभ्यन्तरं तथा ।
वाङ्मनःकायभेदाच्च त्रिधा मद्भजनं विदुः ॥
7.2.m: Worship of me is to be known as twofold: external and internal. / And by the division of speech, mind, and body, they know my worship to be threefold.

7.2.s:
tapaḥ karma japo dhyānaṃ jñānaṃ vetyanupūrvaśaḥ |
pañcadhā kathyate sadbhistadeva bhajanaṃ punaḥ ||
7.2.d:
तपः कर्म जपो ध्यानं ज्ञानं वेत्यनुपूर्वशः ।
पञ्चधा कथ्यते सद्भिस्तदेव भजनं पुनः ॥
7.2.m: Austerity, action, recitation, meditation, or knowledge in proper order: / that same worship is said again by the good to be fivefold.

7.2.s:
anyātmaviditaṃ bāhyamasmadabhyarcanādikam |
tadeva tu svasaṃvedyamābhyantaramudāhṛtam ||
7.2.d:
अन्यात्मविदितं बाह्यमस्मदभ्यर्चनादिकम् ।
तदेव तु स्वसंवेद्यमाभ्यन्तरमुदाहृतम् ॥
7.2.m: Known to others is external worship and so forth directed to me; / but that which is experienced within oneself is called internal.

7.2.s:
manomatpravaṇaṃ cittaṃ na manomātramucyate |
mannāmaniratā vāṇī vāṅmatā khalu netarā ||
7.2.d:
मनोमत्प्रवणं चित्तं न मनोमात्रमुच्यते ।
मन्नामनिरता वाणी वाङ्मता खलु नेतरा ॥
7.2.m: Mind is said to be consciousness inclined toward me, not mere mind. / Speech is considered to be speech intent on my names, indeed none other.

7.2.s:
liṅgairmacchāsanādiṣṭaistripuṇḍrādibhiraṅkitaḥ |
mamopacāranirataḥ kāyaḥ kāyo na cetaraḥ ||
7.2.d:
लिङ्गैर्मच्छासनादिष्टैस्त्रिपुण्ड्रादिभिरङ्कितः ।
ममोपचारनिरतः कायः कायो न चेतरः ॥
7.2.m: Marked with the insignia ordained by my teaching, such as the triple mark, / and intent on my service, the body is a body, and not otherwise.

7.2.s:
madarcā karma vijñeyaṃ bāhye yāgādinocyate |
madarthe dehasaṃśoṣastapaḥ kṛcchrādi no matam ||
7.2.d:
मदर्चा कर्म विज्ञेयं बाह्ये यागादिनोच्यते ।
मदर्थे देहसंशोषस्तपः कृच्छ्रादि नो मतम् ॥
7.2.m: Worship of me is to be known as action, which is spoken of externally through sacrifices and the like. / Emaciation of the body for my sake is austerity; penances such as Kṛcchra are not [alone] considered [so].

7.2.s:
japaḥ pañcākṣarābhyāsaḥ praṇavābhyāsa eva ca |
rudrādhyāyādikābhyāso na vedādhyayanādikam ||
7.2.d:
जपः पञ्चाक्षराभ्यासः प्रणवाभ्यास एव च ।
रुद्राध्यायादिकाभ्यासो न वेदाध्ययनादिकम् ॥
7.2.m: Recitation is the practice of the five-syllable mantra and the practice of the syllable Om, / and the practice of the Rudrādhyāya and the like, not the study of the Vedas and so forth.

7.2.s:
dhyānaṃ madrūpacintādyaṃ nātmādyarthasamādhayaḥ |
mamāgamārthavijñānaṃ jñānaṃ nānyārthavedanam ||
7.2.d:
ध्यानं मद्रूपचिन्ताद्यं नात्माद्यर्थसमाधयः ।
ममागमार्थविज्ञानं ज्ञानं नान्यार्थवेदनम् ॥
7.2.m: Meditation is contemplation of my form and the like, not samādhis directed toward the Self or other objects. / Knowledge is the discernment of the meaning of my Āgamas, not the comprehension of other subjects.

7.2.s:
bāhye vābhyantare vātha yatra syānmanaso ratiḥ |
prāgvāsanāvaśāddevi tattvaniṣṭhāṃ samācaret ||
7.2.d:
बाह्ये वाभ्यन्तरे वाथ यत्र स्यान्मनसो रतिः ।
प्राग्वासनावशाद्देवि तत्त्वनिष्ठां समाचरेत् ॥
7.2.m: Whether externally or internally, wherever the mind finds delight / by virtue of former latent impressions, O goddess, one should practice devotion to reality.

7.2.s:
bāhyādābhyantaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhavecchataguṇādhikam |
asaṅkaratvāddoṣāṇāṃ dṛṣṭānāmapyasambhavāt ||
7.2.d:
बाह्यादाभ्यन्तरं श्रेष्ठं भवेच्छतगुणाधिकम् ।
असङ्करत्वाद्दोषाणां दृष्टानामप्यसम्भवात् ॥
7.2.m: The internal is superior to the external, being a hundred times greater, / because of the absence of confusion and the impossibility of visible faults.

7.2.s:
śaucamābhyantaraṃ vidyānna bāhyaṃ śaucamucyate |
antaḥ śaucavimuktātmā śucirapyaśuciryataḥ ||
7.2.d:
शौचमाभ्यन्तरं विद्यान्न बाह्यं शौचमुच्यते ।
अन्तः शौचविमुक्तात्मा शुचिरप्यशुचिर्यतः ॥
7.2.m: One should know internal purification; external is not called purification. / For one whose self is devoid of internal purification is impure, even though [externally] pure.

7.2.s:
bāhyamābhyaṃrtaraṃ caiva bhajanaṃ bhavapūrvakam |
na bhāvarahitaṃ devi vipralambhaikakāraṇam ||
7.2.d:
बाह्यमाभ्यंर्तरं चैव भजनं भवपूर्वकम् ।
न भावरहितं देवि विप्रलम्भैककारणम् ॥
7.2.m: External and internal worship must be preceded by inner feeling. / Without inner feeling, O goddess, it is only a cause of deception.

7.2.s:
kṛtakṛtyasya pūtasya mama kiṃ kriyate naraiḥ |
bahirvābhyantaraṃ vātha mayā bhāvo hi gṛhyate ||
7.2.d:
कृतकृत्यस्य पूतस्य मम किं क्रियते नरैः ।
बहिर्वाभ्यन्तरं वाथ मया भावो हि गृह्यते ॥
7.2.m: What can be done by men for me, who am fulfilled and pure? / Whether external or internal, indeed it is the inner feeling that is accepted by me.

7.2.s:
bhāvaikātmā kriyā devi mama dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ |
manasā karmaṇā vācā hyanapekṣya phalaṃ kvacit ||
7.2.d:
भावैकात्मा क्रिया देवि मम धर्मः सनातनः ।
मनसा कर्मणा वाचा ह्यनपेक्ष्य फलं क्वचित् ॥
7.2.m: An action consisting solely of inner feeling, O goddess, is my eternal duty, / performed through mind, action, or speech without expecting any fruit whatsoever.

7.2.s:
phaloddeśena deveśi laghurmama samāśrayaḥ |
phalārthī tadabhāve māṃ parityaktuṃ kṣamo yataḥ ||
7.2.d:
फलोद्देशेन देवेशि लघुर्मम समाश्रयः ।
फलार्थी तदभावे मां परित्यक्तुं क्षमो यतः ॥
7.2.m: Taking refuge in me with a view to a fruit, O ruler of gods, is minor, / because one seeking a fruit is capable of abandoning me in its absence.

7.2.s:
phalārthino'pi yasyaiva mayi cittaṃ pratiṣṭhitam |
bhāvānurūpaphaladastasyāpyahamanindite ||
7.2.d:
फलार्थिनोऽपि यस्यैव मयि चित्तं प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
भावानुरूपफलदस्तस्याप्यहमनिन्दिते ॥
7.2.m: Even of one seeking a fruit, whose mind is established in me, / I grant the fruit according with the inner feeling, O faultless one.

7.2.s:
phalānapekṣayā yeṣāṃ mano matpravaṇaṃ bhavet |
prārthayeyuḥ phalaṃ paścādbhaktāste'pi mama priyāḥ ||
7.2.d:
फलानपेक्षया येषां मनो मत्प्रवणं भवेत् ।
प्रार्थयेयुः फलं पश्चाद्भक्तास्तेऽपि मम प्रियाः ॥
7.2.m: Those whose mind is inclined toward me without expectation of fruit, / even if they pray for a fruit afterward, are also devotees dear to me.

7.2.s:
prāk saṃskāravaśādeva ye vicintya phalāphale |
vivaśā māṃ prapadyante mama priyatamā matāḥ ||
7.2.d:
प्राक् संस्कारवशादेव ये विचिन्त्य फलाफले ।
विवशा मां प्रपद्यन्ते मम प्रियतमा मताः ॥
7.2.m: Those who, reflecting on fruit and non-fruit solely through the power of past impressions, / surrender to me helplessly, are regarded as dearest to me.

7.2.s:
mallābhānna paro lābhasteṣāmasti yathātatham |
mamāpi lābhastallābhānnāparaḥ parameśvari ||
7.2.d:
मल्लाभान्न परो लाभस्तेषामस्ति यथातथम् ।
ममापि लाभस्तल्लाभान्नापरः परमेश्वरि ॥
7.2.m: For them there is truly no gain higher than the attainment of me; / for me too, O Parameśvarī, there is no gain other than the attainment of them.

7.2.s:
madanugrahatasteṣāṃ bhāvo mayi samarpitaḥ |
phalaṃ paramanirvāṇaṃ prayacchati balādiva ||
7.2.d:
मदनुग्रहतस्तेषां भावो मयि समर्पितः ।
फलं परमनिर्वाणं प्रयच्छति बलादिव ॥
7.2.m: By my grace, the inner feeling surrendered to me / bestows the fruit of supreme liberation, as if by force.

7.2.s:
mahātmanāmananyānāṃ mayi saṃnyastacetasām |
aṣṭadhā lakṣaṇaṃ prāhurmama dharmādhikāriṇām ||
7.2.d:
महात्मनामनन्यानां मयि संन्यस्तचेतसाम् ।
अष्टधा लक्षणं प्राहुर्मम धर्माधिकारिणाम् ॥
7.2.m: Of the great-souled, single-minded ones whose minds are surrendered to me, / who are eligible for my duty, they speak of an eightfold characteristic:

7.2.s:
madbhaktajanavātsalyaṃ pūjāyāṃ cānumodanam |
svayamabhyarcanaṃ caiva madarthe cāṅgaceṣṭitam ||
7.2.d:
मद्भक्तजनवात्सल्यं पूजायां चानुमोदनम् ।
स्वयमभ्यर्चनं चैव मदर्थे चाङ्गचेष्टितम् ॥
7.2.m: affection toward people who are my devotees, rejoicing in worship, / performing worship oneself, bodily exertion for my sake,

7.2.s:
matkathāśravaṇe bhaktiḥ svaranetrāṅgavikriyāḥ |
mamānusmaraṇaṃ nityaṃ yaśca māmupajīvati ||
7.2.d:
मत्कथाश्रवणे भक्तिः स्वरनेत्राङ्गविक्रियाः ।
ममानुस्मरणं नित्यं यश्च मामुपजीवति ॥
7.2.m: devotion in hearing stories about me, transformations of voice, eyes, and limbs, / constant remembrance of me, and one who lives depending on me.

7.2.s:
evamaṣṭavidhaṃ cihnaṃ yasmin mlecche'pi vartate |
sa viprendro muniḥ śrīmān sa yatiḥ sa ca paṇḍitaḥ ||
7.2.d:
एवमष्टविधं चिह्नं यस्मिन् म्लेच्छेऽपि वर्तते ।
स विप्रेन्द्रो मुनिः श्रीमान् स यतिः स च पण्डितः ॥
7.2.m: In whomsoever this eightfold mark exists, even in an outcaste, / he is a foremost twice-born, a sage, a glorious one; he is an ascetic, and he is a learned man.

7.2.s:
na me priyaścaturvedī madbhakto śvapaco'pi yaḥ |
tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ sa ca pūjyo yathā hyaham ||
7.2.d:
न मे प्रियश्चतुर्वेदी मद्भक्तो श्वपचोऽपि यः ।
तस्मै देयं ततो ग्राह्यं स च पूज्यो यथा ह्यहम् ॥
7.2.m: A knower of the four Vedas is not dear to me, but even an outcaste who is my devotee is. / To him gifts should be given, from him gifts should be received, and he should be worshipped just like me.

7.2.s:
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati |
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
7.2.d:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति ।
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
7.2.m:
He who offers me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water, / I am not lost to him, and he is not lost to me.

Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

7.2.s:
īśvara uvāca |
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi bhaktānāmadhikāriṇām |
viduṣāṃ dvijamukhyānāṃ varṇadharmasamāsataḥ ||
7.2.d:
ईश्वर उवाच ।
अथ वक्ष्यामि देवेशि भक्तानामधिकारिणाम् ।
विदुषां द्विजमुख्यानां वर्णधर्मसमासतः ॥

7.2.s:
triḥsnānaṃ cāgnikāryaṃ ca liṅgārcanamanukramam |
dānamīśvarabhāvaśca dayā sarvatra sarvadā ||
7.2.d:
त्रिःस्नानं चाग्निकार्यं च लिङ्गार्चनमनुक्रमम् ।
दानमीश्वरभावश्च दया सर्वत्र सर्वदा ॥

7.2.s:
satyaṃ santoṣamāstikyamahiṃsā sarvajantuṣu |
hrīḥśraddhādhyayanaṃ yogaḥ sadādhyāpanameva ca ||
7.2.d:
सत्यं सन्तोषमास्तिक्यमहिंसा सर्वजन्तुषु ।
ह्रीःश्रद्धाध्ययनं योगः सदाध्यापनमेव च ॥

7.2.s:
vyākhyānaṃ brahmacaryaṃ ca śravaṇaṃ ca tapaḥ kṣamā |
śaucaṃ śikhopavītaṃ ca uṣṇīṣaṃ cottarīyakam ||
7.2.d:
व्याख्यानं ब्रह्मचर्यं च श्रवणं च तपः क्षमा ।
शौचं शिखोपवीतं च उष्णीषं चोत्तरीयकम् ॥
7.2.m:
modesty, faith, study [of scripture], yoga, and always teaching;
exposition, celibacy, listening [to scripture], austerity, patience;

7.2.s:
niṣiddhāsevanaṃ caiva bhasmarudrākṣadhāraṇam |
parvaṇyabhyarcanaṃ devi caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
7.2.d:
निषिद्धासेवनं चैव भस्मरुद्राक्षधारणम् ।
पर्वण्यभ्यर्चनं देवि चतुर्दश्यां विशेषतः ॥

7.2.s:
pānaṃ ca brahmakūrcasya māsi māsi yathāvidhi |
abhyarcanaṃ viśeṣeṇa tenaiva snāpya māṃ priye ||
7.2.d:
पानं च ब्रह्मकूर्चस्य मासि मासि यथाविधि ।
अभ्यर्चनं विशेषेण तेनैव स्नाप्य मां प्रिये ॥
7.2.m:
special worship, having bathed me with that very [mixture], O beloved;
renouncing food from all funeral rites, and avoiding food offered in śrāddha;

7.2.s:
sarvakriyānnasantyāgaḥ śrāddhānnasya ca varjanam |
tathā paryuṣitānnasya yāvakasya viśeṣataḥ ||
7.2.d:
सर्वक्रियान्नसन्त्यागः श्राद्धान्नस्य च वर्जनम् ।
तथा पर्युषितान्नस्य यावकस्य विशेषतः ॥

7.2.s:
madyasya madyagandhasya naivedyasya ca varjanam |
sāmānyaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
7.2.d:
मद्यस्य मद्यगन्धस्य नैवेद्यस्य च वर्जनम् ।
सामान्यं सर्ववर्णानां ब्राह्मणानां विशेषतः ॥

7.2.s:
kṣamā śāntiśca santoṣaḥ satyamasteyameva ca |
brahmacaryaṃ mama jñānaṃ vairāgyaṃ bhasmasevanam ||
7.2.d:
क्षमा शान्तिश्च सन्तोषः सत्यमस्तेयमेव च ।
ब्रह्मचर्यं मम ज्ञानं वैराग्यं भस्मसेवनम् ॥
7.2.m: celibacy, knowledge of me, detachment, application of ash,

7.2.s:
sarvasaṅganivṛttiśca daśaitāni viśeṣataḥ |
liṅgāni yogināṃ bhūyo divā bhikṣāśanaṃ tathā ||
7.2.d:
सर्वसङ्गनिवृत्तिश्च दशैतानि विशेषतः ।
लिङ्गानि योगिनां भूयो दिवा भिक्षाशनं तथा ॥
7.2.m:
and turning away from all attachment—these ten in particular
are the marks of yogins; and likewise eating alms [only] by day.

7.2.s:
vānaprasthāśramasthānāṃ samānamidamiṣyate |
rātrau na bhojanaṃ kāryaṃ sarveṣāṃ brahmacāriṇām ||
7.2.d:
वानप्रस्थाश्रमस्थानां समानमिदमिष्यते ।
रात्रौ न भोजनं कार्यं सर्वेषां ब्रह्मचारिणाम् ॥
7.2.m:
This is held to be the same for those residing in the forest-hermit stage of life.
No meal should be taken at night by any celibate students.

7.2.s:
adhyāpanaṃ yājanaṃ ca kṣatriyasyāpratigrahaḥ |
vaiśyasya ca viśeṣeṇa mayā nātra vidhīyate ||
7.2.d:
अध्यापनं याजनं च क्षत्रियस्याप्रतिग्रहः ।
वैश्यस्य च विशेषेण मया नात्र विधीयते ॥
7.2.m:
Teaching and performing sacrifices for others, and not receiving gifts for a kṣatriya
and especially for a vaiśya, are not prescribed by me here.

7.2.s:
rakṣaṇaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ yuddhe śatruvadhastathā |
duṣṭapakṣimṛgāṇāṃ ca duṣṭānāṃ śātanaṃ nṛṇām ||
7.2.d:
रक्षणं सर्ववर्णानां युद्धे शत्रुवधस्तथा ।
दुष्टपक्षिमृगाणां च दुष्टानां शातनं नृणाम् ॥
7.2.m:
The protection of all classes, the slaying of enemies in battle,
and the destruction of harmful birds, wild beasts, and wicked men;

7.2.s:
aviśvāsaśca sarvatra viśvāso mama yogiṣu |
strīsaṃsargaśca kāleṣu camūrakṣaṇameva ca ||
7.2.d:
अविश्वासश्च सर्वत्र विश्वासो मम योगिषु ।
स्त्रीसंसर्गश्च कालेषु चमूरक्षणमेव च ॥
7.2.m:
distrust everywhere, and trust in my yogins;
intercourse with women [only] at the proper times, and protection of the army;

7.2.s:
sadā sañcāritaiścārairlokavṛttāntavedanam |
sadāstradhāraṇaṃ caiva bhasmakañcukadhāraṇam ||
7.2.d:
सदा सञ्चारितैश्चारैर्लोकवृत्तान्तवेदनम् ।
सदास्त्रधारणं चैव भस्मकञ्चुकधारणम् ॥
7.2.m:
learning the news of the world through spies kept constantly in motion;
always bearing weapons, and wearing an armor of holy ashes—

7.2.s:
rājñāṃ mamāśramasthānāmeṣa dharmasya saṅgrahaḥ |
gorakṣaṇaṃ ca vāṇijyaṃ kṛṣirvaiśyasya kathyate ||
7.2.d:
राज्ञां ममाश्रमस्थानामेष धर्मस्य सङ्ग्रहः ।
गोरक्षणं च वाणिज्यं कृषिर्वैश्यस्य कथ्यते ॥
7.2.m:
this is the summary of duty for kings devoted to my order.
The protection of cattle, trade, and agriculture are stated for the vaiśya.

7.2.s:
śuśrūṣetaravarṇānāṃ dharmaḥ śūdrasya kathyate |
udyānakaraṇaṃ caiva mama kṣetrasamāśrayaḥ ||
7.2.d:
शुश्रूषेतरवर्णानां धर्मः शूद्रस्य कथ्यते ।
उद्यानकरणं चैव मम क्षेत्रसमाश्रयः ॥
7.2.m:
Service to the other classes is stated as the duty of the śūdra,
as well as laying out gardens and taking refuge in my sacred sites.

7.2.s:
dharmapatnyāstu gamanaṃ gṛhasthasya vidhīyate |
brahmacaryaṃ vanasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ||
7.2.d:
धर्मपत्न्यास्तु गमनं गृहस्थस्य विधीयते ।
ब्रह्मचर्यं वनस्थानां यतीनां ब्रह्मचारिणाम् ॥
7.2.m:
Approaching only one’s lawful wife is prescribed for the householder;
celibacy is prescribed for forest-dwellers, ascetics, and celibate students.

7.2.s:
strīṇāṃ tu bhartṛśuśrūṣā dharmo nānyaḥ sanātanaḥ |
mamārcanaṃ ca kalyāṇi niyogo bharturasti cet ||
7.2.d:
स्त्रीणां तु भर्तृशुश्रूषा धर्मो नान्यः सनातनः ।
ममार्चनं च कल्याणि नियोगो भर्तुरस्ति चेत् ॥
7.2.m:
For women, service to the husband is the eternal duty, none other;
and worship of me, O auspicious one, if there is the command of the husband.

7.2.s:
yā nārī bhartṛśuśrūṣāṃ vihāya vratatatparā |
sā nārī narakaṃ yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
7.2.d:
या नारी भर्तृशुश्रूषां विहाय व्रततत्परा ।
सा नारी नरकं याति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
7.2.m:
The woman who abandons service to her husband and is intent on vows,
that woman goes to hell; there is no doubt about this.

7.2.s:
atha bhartṛvihīnāyā vakṣye dharmaṃ sanātanam |
vrataṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ śaucaṃ bhūśayyānaktabhojanam ||
7.2.d:
अथ भर्तृविहीनाया वक्ष्ये धर्मं सनातनम् ।
व्रतं दानं तपः शौचं भूशय्यानक्तभोजनम् ॥
7.2.m:
Now I shall declare the eternal duty of a woman deprived of her husband:
vows, gifting, austerity, purity, sleeping on the ground, eating [only] at night,

7.2.s:
brahmacaryaṃ sadā snānaṃ bhasmanā salilena vā |
śāntirmaunaṃ kṣamā nityaṃ saṃvibhāgo yathāvidhi ||
7.2.d:
ब्रह्मचर्यं सदा स्नानं भस्मना सलिलेन वा ।
शान्तिर्मौनं क्षमा नित्यं संविभागो यथाविधि ॥
7.2.m:
celibacy, constant bathing with holy ashes or with water,
tranquillity, silence, forbearance always, and proper distribution [of food],

7.2.s:
aṣṭābhyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ ca vidhivadupavāso mamārcanam ||
7.2.d:
अष्टाभ्यां च चतुर्दश्यां पौर्णमास्यां विशेषतः ।
एकादश्यां च विधिवदुपवासो ममार्चनम् ॥
7.2.m:
and fasting according to rule on the eighth, the fourteenth, especially on the full moon,
and on the eleventh day, and worship of me.

7.2.s:
iti saṅkṣepataḥ prokto mayāśramaniṣeviṇām |
brahmakṣatraviśāṃ devi yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ||
7.2.d:
इति सङ्क्षेपतः प्रोक्तो मयाश्रमनिषेविणाम् ।
ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां देवि यतीनां ब्रह्मचारिणाम् ॥
7.2.m:
Thus has been briefly declared by me, O goddess, for those who observe the stages of life—
for Brahmins, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, ascetics, and celibate students,

7.2.s:
tathaiva vānaprasthānāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ ca sundari |
śūdrāṇāmatha nārīṇāṃ dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ ||
7.2.d:
तथैव वानप्रस्थानां गृहस्थानां च सुन्दरि ।
शूद्राणामथ नारीणां धर्म एष सनातनः ॥
7.2.m:
likewise for forest-dwellers and householders, O beautiful woman,
and for śūdras and women—this eternal duty.

7.2.s:
dhyeyastvayā'haṃ deveśi sadā jāpyaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ |
vedoktamakhilaṃ dharmamiti dharmārthasaṅgrahaḥ ||
7.2.d:
ध्येयस्त्वयाऽहं देवेशि सदा जाप्यः षडक्षरः ।
वेदोक्तमखिलं धर्ममिति धर्मार्थसङ्ग्रहः ॥
7.2.m:
I must be meditated upon by you, O queen of gods; the six-syllabled mantra must be recited always.
All duty taught in the Veda—such is the summary of duty and purpose.

7.2.s:
atha ye mānavā loke svecchayā dhṛtavigrahāḥ |
bhāvātiśayasampannāḥ pūrvasaṃskārasaṃyutāḥ ||
7.2.d:
अथ ये मानवा लोके स्वेच्छया धृतविग्रहाः ।
भावातिशयसम्पन्नाः पूर्वसंस्कारसंयुताः ॥
7.2.m:
Now, those human beings in the world who have assumed a body of their own will,
endowed with an excess of devotion and possessing previous impressions,

7.2.s:
viraktā vānuraktā vā stryādīnāṃ viṣayeṣvapi |
pāpairna te vilimpante padmapatramivāmbhasā ||
7.2.d:
विरक्ता वानुरक्ता वा स्त्र्यादीनां विषयेष्वपि ।
पापैर्न ते विलिम्पन्ते पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ॥
7.2.m: whether detached or attached even to sense-objects such as women—

7.2.s:
teṣāṃ mamātmavijñānaṃ viśuddhānāṃ vivekinām |
matprasādādviśuddhānāṃ duḥkhamāśramarakṣaṇam ||
7.2.d:
तेषां ममात्मविज्ञानं विशुद्धानां विवेकिनाम् ।
मत्प्रसादाद्विशुद्धानां दुःखमाश्रमरक्षणम् ॥
7.2.m:
For them, purified and discerning, there is knowledge of my Self.
For those purified by my grace, suffering comes from guarding an āśrama. / There is neither anything to be done nor left undone, nor is samādhi their highest recourse.

7.2.s:
nāsti kṛtyamakṛtyaṃ ca samādhirvā parāyaṇam |
na vidhirna niṣedhaśca teṣāṃ mama yathā tathā ||
7.2.d:
नास्ति कृत्यमकृत्यं च समाधिर्वा परायणम् ।
न विधिर्न निषेधश्च तेषां मम यथा तथा ॥
7.2.m: There is neither injunction nor prohibition for them, just as there is none for me.

7.2.s:
tatheha paripūrṇasya sādhyaṃ mama na vidyate |
tathaiva kṛtakṛtyānāṃ teṣāmapi na saṃśayaḥ ||
7.2.d:
